_misses++;\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    entry.touch();\n    _hits++;\n    BridgeLogger.debug('Cache', 'Hit: $key');\n    return entry.value;\n  }\n\n  Future<void> set(\n    String key,\n `BridgeInspector` بعد از dispose هنوز event می‌فرسته**\n```dart\n// bridge_inspector.dart\n_bridgeSub = bridge.messageStream.listen((message) {\n  // ...\n  if (!_logController.isClosed) {\n    _logController.add(entry); // بررسی می‌کنه ولی...\n  }\n});\n// اگه dispose بشه و بعد event بیاد، _log.add() بدون چک اضافه می‌شه\n```\n\n---\n\n### ۲. باگ‌های Medium\n\n**باگ ۱۱: `PermissionManager` cache مشکل دارد**\n```dart\n// permission_manager.dart\nFuture<bool> check(String permission) async {\n  if (_cache.containsKey(permission)) {\n    return cached == PermissionStatus.granted;\n    // cache هیچ‌وقت expire نمی‌شه\n    // اگه کاربر permission رو revoke کنه، هنوز granted برمی‌گردونه\n  }\n```\n\n**باگ ۱۲: `RateLimiter` در concurrent calls thread-safe نیست**\n```dart\n// rate_limiter.dart\nRateLimitResult consume() {\n  final now = DateTime.now();\n  final windowStart = now.subtract(rule.window);\n  _calls.removeWhere((time) => time.isBefore(windowStart));\n  // در Dart isolate single-thread هست ولی async gaps می‌تونه مشکل‌ساز بشه\n```\n\n**باگ ۱۳: `WebViewHostConfig` در `webview_host.dart` استفاده نمی‌شه**\n```dart\n// webview_host.dart\n// enableDebugging و allowFileAccess در config هست\n// ولی هیچ‌کدوم در WebViewController apply نمی‌شن!\n_controller = WebViewController()\n  ..setJavaScriptMode(JavaScriptMode.unrestricted)\n  // config.enableDebugging → هیچ‌جا استفاده نشده\n  // config.allowFileAccess → هیچ‌جا استفاده نشده\n```\n\n**باگ ۱۴: `Plugin._initialized` private field مشکل دارد**\n```dart\n// plugin_interface.dart\nabstract class Plugin {\n  bool _initialized = false;\n  // این field در subclass‌ها قابل دسترسی نیست\n  // ولی isReady از اون می‌خونه - ok هست\n  // ولی اگه initialize دوبار صدا زده بشه، onInitialize دوبار اجرا می‌شه\n```\n\n**باگ ۱۵: `PluginRegistry` event emitter null safety**\n```dart\n// plugin_registry.dart\nFuture<void> emitEvent(String event, dynamic data) async {\n  if (_eventEmitter != null) {\n    await _eventEmitter!(event, data); // ok\n  }\n  // ولی setEventEmitter قبل از register صدا زده می‌شه\n  // پلاگین‌ها در initialize می‌تونن event emit کنن - null می‌شه\n```\n\n---\n\n### ۳. نقاط ضعف معماری\n\n**ضعف ۱: Sub-package‌ها pubspec.yaml جداگانه دارن ولی در workspace اصلی path dependency تعریف نشده**\n\n```yaml\n# pubspec.yaml اصلی - این‌ها تعریف نشدن:\n# core:\n#   path: مشکل اصلی\n\nالان WebView فقط یک HTML ساده inline اجرا می‌کند. برای اجرای پروژه‌های build شده (Angular، React، Vue) باید این معماری پیاده‌سازی بشه:\n\n### روش ۱: Load از Assets (بهترین برای production)\n\n**مرحله ۱: ساختار پوشه**\n```\nassets/\n  web/\n    index.html\n    main.js\n    styles.css\n    chunk.123.js\n    ...\n```\n\n**مرحله ۲: pubspec.yaml**\n```yaml\nflutter:\n  assets:\n    - assets/web/\n    - assets/web/index.html\n    # برای Angular build output:\n    # ng build --output-path=assets/web --base-href=/\n```\n\n**مرحله ۳: WebViewHost را تغییر دهید**\n```dart\n// lib/packages/core/lib/src/runtime/webview_host.dart\n\nclass WebViewHost extends StatefulWidget {\n  final String? initialUrl;\n  final String? initialHtml;\n  final String? assetPath;      // 👈 اضافه کن\n  final String? localDirectory; // 👈 اضافه کن\n  // ...\n}\n\nclass _WebViewHostState extends State<WebViewHost> {\n  \n  void _initController() {\n    _controller = WebViewController()\n      ..setJavaScriptMode(JavaScriptMode.unrestricted)\n      // برای Android - باید file access فعال بشه\n      ..setBackgroundColor(Colors.transparent)\n      ..addJavaScriptChannel('flutterBridge', onMessageReceived: _onJsMessage)\n      ..addJavaScriptChannel('__bridgeInternal', onMessageReceived: _onInternalMessage);\n\n    widget.bridge.setWebViewController(_controller);\n    _loadContent();\n  }\n\n  Future<void> _loadContent() async {\n    if (widget.assetPath != null) {\n      // روش ۱: از assets\n      await _loadFromAssets(widget.assetPath!);\n    } else if (widget.localDirectory != null) {\n      // روش ۲: از فایل‌های extract شده\n      await _loadFromDirectory(widget.localDirectory!);\n    } else if (widget.initialHtml != null) {\n      await _controller.loadHtmlString(widget.initialHtml!);\n    } else if (widget.initialUrl != null && widget.initialUrl!.isNotEmpty) {\n      await _controller.loadRequest(Uri.parse(widget.initialUrl!));\n    }\n  }\n\n  Future<void> _loadFromAssets(String assetPath) async {\n    // برای webview_flutter v4+ می‌تونیم مستقیم load کنیم\n    await _controller.loadFlutterAsset(assetPath);\n  }\n\n  Future<void> _loadFromDirectory(String dirPath) async {\n    final file = File('$dirPath/index.html');\n    if (await file.exists()) {\n      await _controller.loadRequest(\n        Uri.file('$dirPath/index.html'),\n      );\n    }\n  }\n}\n```\n\n**مرحله ۴: AndroidManifest.xml باید آپدیت بشه**\n```xml\n<manifest xmlns:android=\"http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android\">\n    <!-- اضافه کن -->\n    <uses-permission android:name=\"android.permission.INTERNET\"/>\n    <uses-permission android:name=\"android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE\"/>\n    <uses-permission android:name=\"android.permission.CAMERA\"/>\n    <uses-permission android:name=\"android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE\"/>\n    <uses-permission android:name=\"android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE\"/>\n    <uses-permission android:name=\"android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION\"/>\n    <uses-permission android:name=\"android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION\"/>\n    \n    <application\n        android:label=\"sweetmelon\"\n        android:name=\"${applicationName}\"\n        android:icon=\"@mipmap/ic_launcher\"\n        android:usesCleartextTraffic=\"true\"> <!-- برای dev -->\n```\n\n### روش ۲: Load از zip فایل (پویا - Dynamic Loading)\n\n```dart\n// lib/services/web_app_loader.dart\n\nimport 'package:archive/archive.dart';\nimport 'package:dio/dio.dart';\nimport 'package:path_provider/path_provider.dart';\n\nclass WebAppLoader {\n  final Dio _dio = Dio();\n  \n  /// دانلود و extract کردن پروژه Angular/React از server\n  Future<String> loadFromUrl(String zipUrl) async {\n    final appDir = await getApplicationDocumentsDirectory();\n    final webDir = Directory('${appDir.path}/web_app');\n    \n    // اگه قبلاً extract شده، همون رو برگردون\n    final indexFile = File('${webDir.path}/index.html');\n    if (await indexFile.exists()) {\n      return webDir.path;\n    }\n    \n    // دانلود zip\n    final zipPath = '${appDir.path}/web_app.zip';\n    await _dio.download(zipUrl, zipPath);\n    \n    // Extract\n    await _extractZip(zipPath, webDir.path);\n    \n    return webDir.path;\n  }\n  \n  /// Load از assets (پروژه Angular که build شده و داخل assets گذاشتیم)\n  Future<String> loadFromAssets(String assetPrefix) async {\n    final appDir = await getApplicationDocumentsDirectory();\n    final webDir = Directory('${appDir.path}/web_app');\n    await webDir.create(recursive: true);\n    \n    // copy از assets به filesystem\n    // این لازمه چون WebView نمی‌تونه مستقیم از assets چندین فایل بخونه\n    final manifestContent = await rootBundle.loadString('AssetManifest.json');\n    final manifest = jsonDecode(manifestContent) as Map<String, dynamic>;\n    \n    final webAssets = manifest.keys\n        .where((key) => key.startsWith(assetPrefix))\n        .toList();\n    \n    for (final assetKey in webAssets) {\n      final relativePath = assetKey.replaceFirst(assetPrefix, '');\n      final targetFile = File('${webDir.path}/$relativePath');\n      await targetFile.parent.create(recursive: true);\n      \n      final data = await rootBundle.load(assetKey);\n      await targetFile.writeAsBytes(data.buffer.asUint8List());\n    }\n    \n    return webDir.path;\n  }\n  \n  Future<void> _extractZip(String zipPath, String targetDir) async {\n    final bytes = await File(zipPath).readAsBytes();\n    final archive = ZipDecoder().decodeBytes(bytes);\n    \n    for (final file in archive) {\n      final filename = file.name;\n      if (file.isFile) {\n        final outFile = File('$targetDir/$filename');\n        await outFile.parent.create(recursive: true);\n        await outFile.writeAsBytes(file.content as List<int>);\n      }\n    }\n  }\n}\n```\n\n### روش ۳: استفاده از `flutter_inappwebview` (قوی‌ترین روش)\n\n```yaml\ndependencies:\n  flutter_inappwebview: ^6.0.0\n```\n\n```dart\n// این پکیج قابلیت‌های بسیار بیشتری داره:\n// - Load از local files\n// - JavaScript injection پیشرفته\n// - Cookie management\n// - Custom scheme handler\n// - Service Worker support (برای PWA های Angular)\n\nimport 'package:flutter_inappwebview/flutter_inappwebview.dart';\n\nclass AdvancedWebViewHost extends StatefulWidget {\n  // ...\n}\n\nclass _AdvancedWebViewHostState extends State<AdvancedWebViewHost> {\n  InAppWebViewController? _controller;\n  \n  @override\n  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n    return InAppWebView(\n      initialUrlRequest: URLRequest(\n        url: WebUri.uri(Uri.parse('http://localhost:8080')),\n      ),\n      // یا load از local file:\n      initialData: InAppWebViewInitialData(\n        data: htmlContent,\n        mimeType: 'text/html',\n        encoding: 'utf-8',\n        baseUrl: WebUri('file:///android_asset/'),\n      ),\n      initialSettings: InAppWebViewSettings(\n        javaScriptEnabled: true,\n        allowFileAccess: true,\n        allowFileAccessFromFileURLs: true,\n        allowUniversalAccessFromFileURLs: true,\n        // مهم برای Angular routing:\n        useHybridComposition: true,\n      ),\n      onWebViewCreated: (controller) {\n        _controller = controller;\n        // inject bridge\n        controller.addJavaScriptHandler(\n          handlerName: 'flutterBridge',\n          callback: (args) async {\n            // handle message\n          },\n        );\n      },\n    );\n  }\n}\n```\n\n### مرحله نهایی: Angular Build Configuration\n\nبرای اینکه Angular با این bridge کار کنه:\n\n```typescript\n// src/app/native-bridge.service.ts\ndeclare global {\n  interface Window {\n    Native: {\n      call: (options: {\n        plugin: string;\n        method: string;\n        args?: Record<string, unknown>;\n        timeout?: number;\n      }) => Promise<unknown>;\n      batch: (requests: Array<{plugin: string; method: string; args?: unknown}>) => Promise<unknown[]>;\n      on: (event: string, callback: (data: unknown) => void) => () => void;\n    };\n    flutterBridge: {\n      postMessage: (message: string) => void;\n    };\n  }\n}\n\n@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })\nexport class NativeBridgeService {\n  call<T>(plugin: string, method: string, args?: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<T> {\n    if (!window.Native) {\n      return Promise.reject('Native bridge not available');\n    }\n    return window.Native.call({ plugin, method, args }) as Promise<T>;\n  }\n}\n```\n\n```bash\n# Angular build برای production\nng build --configuration production \\\n CacheEntry {\n  final dynamic value;\n  final DateTime expiresAt;\n  DateTime lastAccessedAt;\n  int hitCount;\n\n  CacheEntry({\n    required this.value,\n    required this.expiresAt,\n  })  : }\n\n  void addNoCachePattern(String pattern) {\n    _noCachePatterns.add(pattern);\n  }\n\n  void removeNoCachePattern(String pattern) {\n    _noCachePatterns.remove(pattern);\n  }\n\n  void entry.value.lastAccessedAt.isBefore(oldestAccess)) {\n        oldestAccess = entry.value.lastAccessedAt;\n        lruKey = entry.key;\n      }\n    }\n\n    if (lruKey != null) {\n      _cache.remove(lruKey);\n      BridgeLogger.debug('Cache', 'Evicted LRU: $lruKey');\n    }\n  }\n\n  void _startCleanupTimer() {\n    _cleanupTimer = Timer.periodic(\n      const Duration(minutes: }\n\n  CacheStats get stats => CacheStats(\n        entries: _cache.length,\n        hits: _hits,\n        misses: _misses,\n        hitRate: (_hits + _misses) > 0 ? _hits / (_hits + _misses) : 0,\n      );\n\n  void dispose() {\n    _cleanupTimer?.cancel();\n    _cache.clear();\n  }\n}\n\nclass CacheStats {\n  final int entries;\n  final int hits;\n  final int misses;\n  final double hitRate;\n\n  const CacheStats({\n    required this.entries,\n    required this.hits,\n    required this.misses,\n    required this.hitRate,\n  });\n\n  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {\n        'entries': entries,\n        'hits': hits,\n        'misses': misses,\n        'hitRate': hitRate,\n      };\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n## 📄 lib/packages/performance/pubspec.yaml\n\n```yaml\nname:     // بررسی stopOnError بعد از اتمام parallel\n      if (options.stopOnError) {\n        final firstError = results.indexWhere((r) => !r.success);\n        if (firstError >= 0) {\n          return results.sublist(0, firstError + 1);\n        }\n      }\n\n      return results;\n    } else {\n      final responses = <PluginResponse>[];\n      for (final request in requests) {\n        final response = await execute(request);\n        responses.add(response);\n        if (options.stopOnError && !response.success) {\n          BridgeLogger.warn(\n            'Manager',\n            'Batch stopped due to error in: ${request.requestId}',\n          );\n          break;\n        }\n      }\n      return responses;\n    }\n  }\n\n  PluginResponse _errorResponse(\n    String requestId,\n    PluginErrorCode code,\n    String message, {\n    String? stackTrace,\n  }) {\n    return PluginResponse.failure(\n      requestId: requestId,\n      error: PluginError(\n        code: code,\n        message: message,\n        stackTrace: stackTrace,\n      ),\n    );\n  }\n\n  String _buildCacheKey(PluginRequest request) {\n    final sortedArgs = _sortedJsonEncode(request.args);\n    return '${request.plugin}:${request.method}:$sortedArgs';\n  }\n\n  String _sortedJsonEncode(Map<String, dynamic> map) {\n    final sortedKeys = map.keys.toList()..sort();\n    final sortedMap = <String, dynamic>{};\n    for (final key in sortedKeys) {\n      final value = map[key];\n      if (value is Map<String, dynamic>) {\n        sortedMap[key] = jsonDecode(_sortedJsonEncode(value));\n      } ) {\n    final key = '$plugin.$method';\n    _stats[key] ??= PluginStats(plugin: plugin, method: method);\n    _stats[key]!.record(timeMs, fromCache);\n  }\n\n  void _emitTrace({\n    required String _safeRelativePath(explicitPath!)\n        : p.join('downloads', fileName);\n\n    final outputFile = File(p.join(root.path, relative));\n\n    if (await outputFile.exists() && !overwrite) {\n      return {\n        'saved': false,\n        'reason': 'already_exists',\n        'path': outputFile.path,\n      };\n    }\n\n    await outputFile.parent.create(recursive: true);\n\n    final client = http.Client();\n\n    try {\n      final response = await client\n          .get(uri, headers: headers)\n          .timeout(Duration(milliseconds: timeoutMs));\n\n      if (response.statusCode < 200 || response.statusCode >= 300) {\n        return {\n          'saved': false,\n          'statusCode': response.statusCode,\n          'reason': 'http_error',\n        };\n      }\n\n      await outputFile.writeAsBytes(response.bodyBytes, flush: true);\n\n      final mimeType = response.headers['content-type'] ??\n          lookupMimeType(outputFile.path) ??\n          'application/octet-stream';\n\n      return {\n        'saved': true,\n        'statusCode': response.statusCode,\n        'path': outputFile.path,\n        'fileName': p.basename(outputFile.path),\n        'size': response.bodyBytes.length,\n        'mimeType': mimeType,\n        'baseDir': baseDir,\n      };\n    } finally {\n      client.close();\n    }\n  }\n\n  Uri _buildUri(\n    String url,\n    Map<String, dynamic>? query,\n  ) {\n    final uri = Uri.parse(url);\n\n    if (query == null || query.isEmpty) {\n      return uri;\n    }\n\n    final merged = Map<String, String>.from(uri.queryParameters);\n    query.forEach((key, value) {\n      if (value != null) {\n        merged[key] = value.toString();\n      }\n    });\n\n    return uri.replace(queryParameters: merged);\n  }\n\n  void _validateUrlScheme(Uri uri) {\n    if (uri.scheme != 'http' && uri.scheme != 'https') {\n      throw ArgumentError('Only http and https URLs are supported');\n    }\n  }\n\n  Map<String, String> _parseHeaders(dynamic raw) {\n    if (raw == null) return {};\n    if (raw is Map) {\n      return raw.map(\n        (key, value) => MapEntry(key.toString(), value.toString()),\n      );\n    }\n    return {};\n  }\n\n  void _applyBody({\n    required http.Request request,\n    required dynamic body,\n    required String bodyType,\n  }) {\n    if (bodyType == 'json' || (bodyType == 'auto' && (body is Map || body is List))) {\n      request.headers.putIfAbsent('content-type', () => 'application/json');\n      request.body = jsonEncode(body);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (bodyType == 'form' && body is Map) {\n      request.headers.putIfAbsent(\n        'content-type',\n        () => 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',\n      );\n      request.bodyFields = body.map(\n        (key, value) => MapEntry(key.toString(), value.toString()),\n      );\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (body is String) {\n      request.body = body;\n      return;\n    }\n\n    request.body = body.toString();\n  }\n\n  dynamic _decodeResponseBody(http.Response response, String responseType) {\n    final contentType = response.headers['content-type'] ?? '';\n\n    if (responseType == 'base64') {\n      return base64Encode(response.bodyBytes);\n    }\n\n    if (responseType == 'json' ||\n        (responseType == 'auto' && contentType.contains('application/json'))) {\n      try {\n        return jsonDecode(response.body);\n      } catch (_) {\n        return response.body;\n      }\n    }\n\n    if (responseType == 'bytes') {\n      return base64Encode(response.bodyBytes);\n    }\n\n    return response.body;\n  }\n\n  Future<Directory> _resolveBaseDir(String baseDir) async {\n    switch (baseDir) {\n      case 'documents':\n        return getApplicationDocumentsDirectory();\n      case 'cache':\n        return getApplicationCacheDirectory();\n      case 'support':\n        return getApplicationSupportDirectory();\n      case 'temporary':\n      case 'temp':\n        return getTemporaryDirectory();\n      default:\n        throw FileSystemException('Unsupported baseDir: $baseDir');\n    }\n  }\n\n  String _fileNameFromUri(Uri uri) {\n    final name = uri.pathSegments.isNotEmpty ? uri.pathSegments.last : 'download.bin';\n    return name.isEmpty ? 'download.bin' : name;\n  }\n\n  String _safeRelativePath(String input) {\n    final normalized = p.normalize(input.replaceAll('\\\\', '/').trim());\n\n    if (normalized.isEmpty || normalized == '.') {\n      throw const FileSystemException('Invalid path');\n    }\n\n    if (p.isAbsolute(normalized) ||\n        normalized.startsWith('..') ||\n        normalized.contains('../') ||\n        normalized == '..') {\n      throw const FileSystemException('Path traversal detected');\n    }\n\n    return normalized;\n  }\n\n  @override\n  Future<ValidationResult> validateArgs(\n    String method,\n    Map<String, dynamic> args,\n  ) async {\n    switch (method) {\n      case 'request':\n      case 'get':\n      case 'post':\n      case 'put':\n      case 'patch':\n      case 'delete':\n      case 'download':\n        final url = args['url'];\n        if (url is! String || url.isEmpty) {\n          return ValidationResult.invalid(\n            'url is required and must be a non-empty string',\n          );\n        }\n        return ValidationResult.valid();\n      default:\n        return ValidationResult.valid();\n    }\n  }\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n# 11) Intent / Deep Link Plugin\n\n## 📄 `lib/plugins/intent_link/lib/intent_link_plugin.dart`\n\n```dart\nimport 'dart:async';\n\nimport 'package:app_links/app_links.dart';\nimport 'package:sweetmelon/packages/core/lib/core.dart';\nimport 'package:sweetmelon/packages/plugin_engine/lib/plugin_engine.dart';\nimport 'package:url_launcher/url_launcher.dart';\n\ntypedef IntentEventEmitter = Future<void> Function(\n  String event,\n  dynamic data,\n);\n\nclass IntentLinkPlugin extends Plugin {\n  final IntentEventEmitter? production \\\n  --output-path /path/to/flutter/assets/www \\\n  --base-href ./\n```\n\n## ۲) اضافه کردن Bridge SDK\n\nفایل `native-sdk.js` را در `angular.json` اضافه کنید:\n\n```json\n\"scripts\": [\n  \"src/assets/native-sdk.js\"\n]\n```\n\nیا در `index.html`:\n\n```html\n<script src=\"assets/native-sdk.js\"></script>\n```\n\n## ۳) سرویس Angular\n\nفایل `src/app/services/native-bridge.service.ts`:\n\n```typescript\nimport { Injectable, NgZone } from '@angular/core';\n\ndeclare const NativeSDK: any;\n\n@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })\nexport class NativeBridgeService {\n  private ready = false;\n\n  constructor(private zone: NgZone) {}\n\n  async init(): Promise<void> {\n    if (this.ready) return;\n    await NativeSDK.waitForReady(10000);\n    this.ready = true;\n  }\n\n  async call<T = any>(plugin: string, method: string, args?: any): Promise<T> {\n    await this.init();\n    return NativeSDK.call(plugin, method, args || {});\n  }\n\n  on(event: string, callback: (data: any) => void): () => void {\n    return NativeSDK.on(event, (data: any) => {\n      this.zone.run(() => callback(data));\n    });\n  }\n\n  // Shortcut methods\n\n  get storage() { return NativeSDK.storage; }\n  get secureStorage() { return NativeSDK.secureStorage; }\n  get http() { return NativeSDK.http; }\n  get deviceInfo() { return NativeSDK.deviceInfo; }\n  get permission() { return NativeSDK.permission; }\n  get connectivity() { return NativeSDK.connectivity; }\n  get clipboard() { return NativeSDK.clipboard; }\n  get share() { return NativeSDK.share; }\n  get notification() { return NativeSDK.notification; }\n  get statusBar() { return NativeSDK.statusBar; }\n  get orientation() { return NativeSDK.orientation; }\n  get haptic() { return NativeSDK.haptic; }\n  get keyboard() { return NativeSDK.keyboard; }\n  get backButton() { return NativeSDK.backButton; }\n  get intent() { return NativeSDK.intent; }\n  get fileSystem() { return NativeSDK.fileSystem; }\n  get camera() { return NativeSDK.camera; }\n  get geolocation() { return NativeSDK.geolocation; }\n  get appLifecycle() { return NativeSDK.appLifecycle; }\n}\n```\n\n## ۴) استفاده در Component\n\n```typescript\nimport { Component, OnInit, OnDestroy } from '@angular/core';\nimport { NativeBridgeService } from './services/native-bridge.service';\n\n@Component({\n  selector: 'app-root',\n  template: `\n    <div>\n      <p>Online: {{ isOnline }}</p>\n      <p>Device: {{ deviceModel }}</p>\n      <button (click)=\"saveData()\">Save</button>\n      <button (click)=\"loadData()\">Load</button>\n    </div>\n  `\n})\nexport class AppComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy {\n  isOnline = true;\n  deviceModel = '';\n\n  private unsubConnectivity?: () => void;\n  private unsubBack?: () => void;\n\n  constructor(private native: NativeBridgeService) {}\n\n  async ngOnInit() {\n    // Device info\n    const info = await this.native.deviceInfo.getAll();\n    this.deviceModel = info.device?.model || 'Unknown';\n\n    // Connectivity watch\n    this.unsubConnectivity = this.native.on('connectivity.change', (data) => {\n      this.isOnline = data.online;\n    });\n\n    // Back button\n    await this.native.backButton.enableIntercept();\n    this.unsubBack = this.native.on('backButton.pressed', () => {\n      // handle back in Angular router\n      window.history.back();\n    });\n  }\n\n  async saveData() {\n    await this.native.storage.set('user', { name: 'Ali', role: 'admin' });\n    await this.native.haptic.lightImpact();\n  }\n\n  async loadData() {\n    const data = await this.native.storage.get('user');\n    console.log('Loaded:', data);\n  }\n\n  ngOnDestroy() {\n    this.unsubConnectivity?.();\n    this.unsubBack?.();\n  }\n}\n```\n\n## ۵) Routing + Back Button\n\nدر `app.module.ts`:\n\n```typescript\nimport { APP_INITIALIZER } from '@angular/core';\n\nexport function initBridge(native: │\n├─────────────────────────────────────────────────┤\n│              Plugin Registry (Dart)              │\n│         35 Plugins registered at startup         │\n├─────────────────────────────────────────────────┤\n│            Android / iOS Native APIs             │\n└─────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n```\n\n---\n\n## 📦 Project Place your HTML project\n\nPut your built HTML/CSS/JS project in:\n```\nassets/www/index.html     ← entry point (fixed)\nassets/www/css/            ← styles\nassets/www/js/             ← scripts\nassets/www/images/         ← images\n```\n\n### 2. Include NativeSDK\n\nAdd to your `index.html`:\n```html\n<script src=\"js/native-sdk.js\"></script>\n```\n\n### 3. Use in JavaScript\n\n```javascript\n// Wait for bridge to be ready\nawait NativeSDK.waitForReady();\n\n// Call any plugin\nconst info = await NativeSDK.deviceInfo.getAll();\nconsole.log(info.device.model);\n\n// Listen to events\nNativeSDK.on('connectivity.change', (data) => {\n  console.log('Online:', data.online);\n});\n```\n\n### 4. Run\n\n```bash\nflutter run\n```\n\n---\n\n## 🔌 All 35 Plugins\n\n| # | Plugin | JS Name | Description |\n|---|--------|---------|-------------|\n| 1 | Permission | `permission` | Check & request traversal protection\n- **Encrypted Storage** — AES-encrypted SharedPreferences\n\n---\n\n## 📄 License\n\nMIT\n```\n\n---\n\n# Plugin READMEs — هر پلاگین جداگانه\n\n---\n\n## 📄 `lib/plugins/permission/README.md`\n\n```markdown\n# Permission Plugin\n\nManage native Android/iOS permissions from JavaScript.\n\n## Plugin Name\n`permission`\n\n## Methods\n\n### `check`\nCheck a single permission status.\n\n**Args:**\n| Param | Type | Required | Description |\n|-------|------|----------|-------------|\n| `permission` | `string` | ✅ | Permission name |\n\n**Returns:**\n```json\n{\n  \"permission\": \"camera\",\n  \"status\": \"granted\",\n  \"granted\": true,\n  \"permanentlyDenied\": false\n}\n```\n\n### `request`\nRequest a single permission.\n\n**Args:** Same as `check`.\n\n**Returns:** Same as `check`.\n\n### `checkMany`\nCheck multiple permissions at once.\n\n**Args:**\n| Param | Type | Required | Description |\n|-------|------|----------|-------------|\n| `permissions` | `string[]` | ✅ | List of permission names |\n\n**Returns:**\n```json\n{\n  \"results\": {\n    \"camera\": { \"status\": \"granted\", \"granted\": true },\n    \"location\": { \"status\": \"denied\", \"granted\": false }\n  }\n}\n```\n\n### `requestMany`\nRequest multiple permissions. Args and returns same as `checkMany`.\n\n### `openSettings`\nOpen app settings page.\n\n**Returns:** `{ \"opened\": true }`\n\n### `getKnownPermissions`\nList all supported permission names.\n\n**Returns:** `{ \"permissions\": [\"camera\", \"storage\", \"location\", ...] }`\n\n## Known Permission Names\n`camera`, `storage`, `manageExternalStorage`, `location`, `locationAlways`,\n`microphone`, `photos`, `notification`, `contacts`, `bluetooth`\n\n## Usage\n```javascript\n// Check\nconst result = await NativeSDK.permission.check('camera');\nif (!result.granted) {\n  await NativeSDK.permission.request('camera');\n}\n\n// Check multiple\nconst all = await NativeSDK.permission.checkMany(['camera', 'location', 'microphone']);\n\n// Open settings if permanently denied\nif (result.permanentlyDenied) {\n  await NativeSDK.permission.openSettings();\n}\n```\n```\n\n---\n\n## 📄 `lib/plugins/app_lifecycle/README.md`\n\n```markdown\n# App Lifecycle Plugin\n\nMonitor app lifecycle state changes (pause, resume, background, etc).\n\n## Plugin Name\n`appLifecycle`\n\n## Methods\n\n### `getState`\nGet current app state.\n\n**Returns:**\n```json\n{ \"state\": \"resumed\" }\n```\n\nPossible states: `resumed`, `inactive`, `paused`, `detached`, `hidden`\n\n### `enableEvents`\nEnable lifecycle change events.\n\n**Returns:** `{ \"enabled\": true }`\n\n### `disableEvents`\nDisable lifecycle change events.\n\n**Returns:** `{ \"enabled\": false }`\n\n### `getInfo`\nGet plugin info including current state and event status.\n\n## Events\n\n### `app.lifecycle.change`\nFired when app state changes.\n```json\n{\n  \"state\": \"paused\",\n  \"previousState\": \"resumed\",\n  \"timestamp\": \"2024-01-15T10:30:00.000Z\"\n}\n```\n\n## Usage\n```javascript\n// Get current state\nconst { state } = await NativeSDK.appLifecycle.getState();\n\n// Listen to changes\nNativeSDK.on('app.lifecycle.change', (data) => {\n  if (data.state === 'paused') {\n    saveFormData();\n  }\n  if (data.state === 'resumed') {\n    refreshData();\n  }\n});\n```\n```\n\n---\n\n## 📄 `lib/plugins/device_info/README.md`\n\n```markdown\n# Device Info Plugin\n\nGet device hardware info and app package info.\n\n## Plugin Name\n`deviceInfo`\n\n## \"model\": \"SM-A525F\",\n  \"isPhysicalDevice\": true,\n  \"version\": {\n    \"sdkInt\": 33,\n    \"release\": \"13\"\n  },\n  \"supportedAbis\": [\"arm64-v8a\", \"armeabi-v7a\"]\n}\n```\n\n### `getAll`\nReturns both device and app info combined.\n\n## Usage\n```javascript\nconst { device, app } = await NativeSDK.deviceInfo.getAll();\nconsole.log(`${device.brand} ${device.model} — `lib/plugins/storage/README.md`\n\n```markdown\n# Storage Plugin\n\nSimple key-value storage using SharedPreferences.\n\n## Plugin Name\n`storage`\n\n## Methods\n\n| Method | Args | Returns |\n|--------|------|---------|\n| `set` | `key: string, value: any` | `true` |\n| `get` | `key: string` | stored value or `null` |\n| `has` | `key: string` | `{ exists: bool }` |\n| `remove` | `key: string` | `true` |\n| `keys` | — | `{ keys: string[] }` |\n| `clear` | — | count of removed keys |\n\n## Usage\n```javascript\nawait NativeSDK.storage.set('user', { name: 'Ali', role: 'admin' });\nconst user = await NativeSDK.storage.get('user');\nconst { keys } = await NativeSDK.storage.keys();\nawait NativeSDK.storage.remove('user');\n```\n\n## Notes\n- Values are JSON-encoded automatically\n- Keys are prefixed with `bridge_` internally\n- For sensitive data, use `secureStorage` instead\n```\n\n---\n\n## 📄 `lib/plugins/file_system/README.md`\n\n```markdown\n# File System Plugin\n\nSandboxed file system access with path traversal protection.\n\n## Plugin Name\n`fileSystem`\n\n## Base Directories\n| Name | Description |\n|------|-------------|\n| `documents` | App documents (default) |\n| `cache` | App cache |\n| `support` | App support |\n| `temporary` | Temporary files |\n\n## Methods\n\n### `getDirectories`\n**Returns:** paths for all base directories\n\n### `writeFile`\n| Param | Type | Required | Default |\n|-------|------|----------|---------|\n| `path` | `string` | ✅ | — |\n| `content` | `string` | ✅ | — |\n| `baseDir` | `string` | — | `documents` |\n| `encoding` | `string` | — | `utf8` |\n| `append` | `bool` | — | `false` |\n\n### `readFile`\n| Param | Type | Required | Default |\n|-------|------|----------|---------|\n| `path` | `string` | ✅ | — |\n| `baseDir` | `string` | — | `documents` |\n| `encoding` | `string` | — | `utf8` |\n\n### `deleteFile`, `fileExists`, `stat`\nAll require `path` and optional `baseDir`.\n\n### `listFiles`\n| Param | Type | Required | Default |\n|-------|------|----------|---------|\n| `path` | `string` | — | `\"\"` (root) |\n| `baseDir` | `string` | — | `documents` |\n| `recursive` | `bool` | — | `false` |\n\n### `createDirectory`, `deleteDirectory`\nRequire `path`, optional `baseDir` and `recursive`.\n\n## Usage\n```javascript\nawait NativeSDK.fileSystem.writeFile('logs/app.log', 'Hello World');\nconst { content } = await NativeSDK.fileSystem.readFile('logs/app.log');\nconst { items } = await NativeSDK.fileSystem.listFiles('logs', { recursive: true });\n```\n\n## Security\n- Path traversal (`..`) is blocked\n- All paths are sandboxed to base directories\n```\n\n---\n\n## 📄 `lib/plugins/http_native/README.md`\n\n```markdown\n# HTTP Native Plugin\n\nNative HTTP client with full |\n|-------|------|----------|---------|\n| `url` | `string` | ✅ | — |\n| `headers` | `object` | — | `{}` |\n| `body` | `any` | — | — |\n| `bodyType` | `string` | — | `auto` |\n| `responseType` | `string` | — | `auto` |\n| `query` | `object` | — | — |\n| `timeoutMs` | `number` | — | `30000` |\n\n**bodyType:** `auto`, `json`, `form`\n**responseType:** `auto`, `json`, `bytes`, `base64`\n\n**Returns:**\n```json\n{\n  \"ok\": true,\n  \"statusCode\": 200,\n  \"headers\": {},\n  \"data\": { ... }\n}\n```\n\n### `download`\n| Param | Type | Required | Default |\n|-------|------|----------|---------|\n| `url` | `string` | ✅ | — |\n| `fileName` | `string` | — | from URL |\n| `baseDir` | `string` | — | `temporary` |\n| `path` | `string` | — | `downloads/` |\n| `overwrite` | `bool` | — | `true` |\n\n## Usage\n```javascript\n// GET\nconst { data } = await NativeSDK.http.get('https://api.example.com/users');\n\n// POST with JSON\nconst result = await queries, and batch operations.\n\n## Plugin Name\n`database`\n\n## Methods\n\n### `open`\n| Param | Type | Required |\n|-------|------|----------|\n| `name` | `string` | ✅ |\n| `version` | `number` | — (default 1) |\n| `onCreate` | `string[]` | — (SQL statements) |\n\n### `query`\n| Param | Type |\n|-------|------|\n| `name` | database name |\n| `table` | table name |\n| `where` | SQL where clause |\n| `whereArgs` | `any[]` |\n| `orderBy` | `string` |\n| `limit` | `number` |\n| `offset` | `number` |\n\n### `insert`\n| Param | Type |\n|-------|------|\n| `name` | database name |\n| `table` | table name |\n| `values` | `{ column: value }` |\n\n### `update`, `delete` — similar with `where`/`whereArgs`\n\n### `rawQuery`, `rawInsert`, `rawUpdate`, `rawDelete`\nDirect SQL execution.\n\n### `batch`\nExecute multiple operations atomically.\n\n### `tableExists`, `deleteDatabase`, `close`\n\n## Usage\n```javascript\n// Open with table creation\nawait NativeSDK.database.open('mydb', {\n  version: 1,\n  onCreate: [\n    'CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name TEXT, email TEXT, age INTEGER)'\n  ]\n});\n\n// Insert\nconst { id } = await NativeSDK.database.insert('mydb', 'users', {\n  name: 'Ali', email: 'ali@test.com', age: 28\n});\n\n// Query\nconst { rows } = await NativeSDK.database.query('mydb', 'users', {\n  where: 'age > ?',\n  whereArgs: [25],\n  orderBy: 'name ASC',\n  limit: 10\n});\n\n// Raw query\nconst result = await NativeSDK.database.rawQuery('mydb',\n  'SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM users WHERE age > ?', [25]\n);\n\n// Batch\nawait NativeSDK.database.batch('mydb', [\n  { type: 'insert', table: 'users', values: { name: 'User1' } },\n  { type: 'insert', table: 'users', values: { name: 'User2' } },\n  { type: 'delete', table: 'users', where: 'age < ?', whereArgs: [18] }\n]);\n```\n```\n\n---\n\n## 📄 `lib/plugins/contacts/README.md`\n\n```markdown\n# Contacts Plugin\n\nRead device contacts.\n\n## Plugin Package Manager (ایده تو ✅)\n**اولویت: بحرانی**\n\nالان ۳۵ پلاگین داریم که همه همیشه لود می‌شن. این مشکلات رو داره:\n- APK سنگین می‌شه\n- permission‌های غیرضروری توی manifest هستن\n- dependency‌های بلااستفاده دانلود می‌شن\n- کاربر نمی‌تونه انتخاب کنه کدوم پلاگین رو بخواد\n\n**راه‌حل:** یک CLI tool یا config system که:\n- پلاگین‌ها رو فعال/غیرفعال کنه\n- permission‌ها رو خودکار مدیریت کنه\n- pubspec رو آپدیت کنه\n- AndroidManifest رو آپدیت کنه\n\n---\n\n## ۲. Error Recovery و Retry System\n**اولویت: بالا**\n\nالان اگه یه call خطا بده، JS باید خودش retry کنه. باید:\n- Auto-retry با exponential backoff\n- Circuit breaker pattern\n- Offline queue (وقتی اینترنت نیست، queue کنه)\n\n---\n\n## ۳. Plugin Hot-Reload / Lazy Loading\n**اولویت: بالا**\n\nپلاگین‌ها رو lazy load کنه، فقط وقتی اولین بار call بشن initialize بشن.\n\n---\n\n## ۴. Automated Testing Framework\n**اولویت: بالا**\n\nتست خودکار برای همه پلاگین‌ها، هم unit test و هم integration test.\n\n---\n\n## ۵. Plugin Versioning و Migration\n**اولویت: متوسط**\n\nوقتی API یه پلاگین تغییر می‌کنه، باید backward compatible باشه یا migration guide داشته باشه.\n\n---\n\n## ۶. WebSocket Plugin\n**اولویت: متوسط**\n\nبرای real-time communication. الان فقط HTTP داریم.\n\n---\n\n## ۷. Background Task Plugin\n**اولویت: متوسط**\n\nاجرای کار در background (sync, fetch, cleanup).\n\n---\n\n## ۸. fallback,\n    String? label,\n    void Function(int attempt, Object error, Duration nextDelay)? onRetry,\n  }) async {\n    final stopwatch = Stopwatch()..start();\n    Object? lastError;\n    int attempt = 0;\n\n    while (attempt <= config.maxRetries) {\n      attempt++;\n\n      try {\n        final result = await action();\n        stopwatch.stop();\n\n        if (attempt > 1) {\n          attempts: attempt,\n          totalDuration: stopwatch.elapsed,\n          success: true,\n        );\n      } catch (e) {\n        lastError = e;\n\n        final isRetryable = _isRetryable(e, config.retryableErrors);\n        final hasMoreRetries = attempt <= config.maxRetries;\n\n        if (!isRetryable || !hasMoreRetries) {\n          break;\n        }\n\n        final delay = _calculateDelay(attempt, config);\n\n        BridgeLogger.warn(\n          'Retry',\n          '${label ?? \"action\"} failed (attempt $attempt/${config.maxRetries + 1}), '\n              'retrying in ${delay.inMilliseconds}ms: $e',\n        );\n\n        onRetry?.call(attempt, e, delay);\n\n        await Future.delayed(delay);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // All retries exhausted — try fallback\n    if (fallback != null) {\n      try {\n        BridgeLogger.info(\n          'Retry',\n          '${label ?? \"action\"} using fallback after $attempt attempts',\n        );\n\n        final result = await fallback(lastError!, attempt);\n        stopwatch.stop();\n\n        return RetryResult<T>(\n          value: result,\n          attempts: attempt,\n          totalDuration: stopwatch.elapsed,\n          success: true,\n        );\n      } catch (fallbackError) {\n        lastError = fallbackError;\n      }\n    }\n\n    stopwatch.stop();\n\n    return RetryResult<T>(\n      error: lastError,\n      attempts: attempt,\n      totalDuration: stopwatch.elapsed,\n      success: false,\n    );\n  }\n\n  static bool _isRetryable(Object error, Set<Type> retryableTypes) {\n    if (retryableTypes.isEmpty) return true;\n\n    for (final type in retryableTypes) {\n      if (error.runtimeType == type) return true;\n    }\n\n    // TimeoutException check\n    if (error is TimeoutException) return true;\n\n    // Check if error message contains network-related text\n    final msg = error.toString().toLowerCase();\n    if (msg.contains('timeout') ||\n        msg.contains('connection') ||\n        msg.contains('socket') ||\n        msg.contains('network')) {\n      return true;\n    }\n\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  static Duration _calculateDelay(int attempt, RetryConfig config) {\n    final delayMs = config.initialDelay.inMilliseconds *\n        _pow(config.backoffMultiplier, attempt - 1);\n\n    final clampedMs = delayMs.clamp(0, config.maxDelay.inMilliseconds);\n\n    // Add jitter (±20%)\n    final jitter = (clampedMs * 0.2 * (DateTime.now().millisecond % 10 / 10))\n        .round();\n\n    return Duration(milliseconds: clampedMs.round() + jitter);\n  }\n\n  static double _pow(double base, int exponent) {\n    double result = 1;\n    for (int i = 0; i < exponent; i++) {\n      result *= base;\n    }\n    return result;\n  }\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n### 📄 `lib/packages/core/lib/src/middleware/circuit_breaker.dart`\n\n```dart\nimport 'dart:async';\n\nimport '../utils/logger.dart';\n\nenum CircuitState {\n  closed, `assets/www/js/native-resilience.js`\n\n```javascript\n(function (global) {\n  'use strict';\n\n  // ═══════════════════════════════════════\n  //  Retry Manager\n  // ═══════════════════════════════════════\n\n  var RetryManager = {\n    defaultConfig: {\n      maxRetries: 3,\n      initialDelayMs: 200,\n      backoffMultiplier: 2.0,\n      maxDelayMs: 10000,\n this.defaultConfig, config);\n    },\n\n    getConfig: function (plugin) {\n      return this._pluginConfigs[plugin] || this.defaultConfig;\n    },\n\n    executeWithRetry: function (fn, options) {\n      options = options || {};\n      var config = Object.assign(\n        {},\n        this.defaultConfig,\n        this._pluginConfigs[options.plugin] || {},\n        options\n      );\n\n      return this._retry(fn, config, 0);\n    },\n\n    _retry: function (fn, config, attempt) {\n      var self = this;\n\n      return fn().catch(function (error) {\n        attempt++;\n\n        var isRetryable = self._isRetryable(error, config.retryableCodes);\n        var hasMoreRetries = attempt <= config.maxRetries;\n\n        if (!isRetryable || !hasMoreRetries) {\n          throw error;\n        }\n\n Attempt ' + attempt + '/' + config.maxRetries +\n          ', retrying in ' + delay + 'ms: ' +\n          (error.message || error.code || JSON.stringify(error))\n        );\n\n        return new _isRetryable: function (error, retryableCodes) {\n      if (!error) return false;\n      var code = error.code || '';\n      return retryableCodes.indexOf(code) !== -1;\n    },\n\n    _calculateDelay: function (attempt, config) {\n      var delay = config.initialDelayMs * Math.pow(config.backoffMultiplier, attempt - 1);\n      delay = Math.min(delay, config.maxDelayMs);\n      var jitter = delay * 0.2 * Math.random();\n      return Math.round(delay + jitter);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // ═══════════════════════════════════════\n  //  Circuit Breaker (JS side)\n  // ═══════════════════════════════════════\n\n  function CircuitBreaker(name, config) {\n    this.name = name;\n    this.config = Object.assign({\n      failureThreshold: 5,\n      resetTimeoutMs: 30000,\n      halfOpenMaxAttempts: 1\n    }, config || {});\n\n    this.state = 'closed';\n    this.failureCount = 0;\n    this.successCount = 0;\n    this.totalCalls = 0;\n    this.halfOpenAttempts = = 'halfOpen';\n        this.halfOpenAttempts = 0;\n        console.log('[CircuitBreaker] [' + this.name + '] → half-open');\n      }\n    }\n  };\n\n  CircuitBreaker.prototype.execute = function (fn) {\n    var self = this;\n\n    if (!this.isAllowed()) {\n      var retryAfter = this.lastFailureTime\n        ? Math.max(0, this.config.resetTimeoutMs - (Date.now() - this.lastFailureTime))\n        : this.config.resetTimeoutMs;\n\n      return Promise.reject({\n        code: 'CIRCUIT_OPEN',\n        message: 'Circuit breaker [' + this.name + '] is open. Retry after ' + retryAfter + 'ms',\n        retryAfterMs: retryAfter\n      });\n    }\n\n    this.totalCalls++;\n\n    if (this.state === 'halfOpen') {\n      this.halfOpenAttempts++;\n    }\n\n CircuitBreaker.prototype._onSuccess = function () {\n    this.successCount++;\n    if (this.state === 'halfOpen') {\n      this.state = 'closed';\n      this.failureCount = 0;\n      console.log('[CircuitBreaker] [' + this.name + '] → closed (recovered)');\n    } else if (this.failureCount > 0) {\n      this.failureCount = Math.max(0, this.failureCount - 1);\n    }\n  };\n\n  CircuitBreaker.prototype._onFailure = function () {\n    this.failureCount++;\n    this.lastFailureTime = Date.now();\n\n    if (this.state === 'halfOpen') {\n      this.state = 'open';\n      console.warn('[CircuitBreaker] [' + this.name + '] → open (half-open test failed)');\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (this.failureCount >= this.config.failureThreshold) {\n      this.state = 'open';\n      console.warn('[CircuitBreaker] [' + this.name + '] → open after ' + this.failureCount + ' failures');\n    }\n  };\n\n  CircuitBreaker.prototype.reset = function () {\n    this.state = 'closed';\n    this.failureCount = 0;\n    this.halfOpenAttempts = 0;\n    this.lastFailureTime = null;\n  };\n\n  CircuitBreaker.prototype.getStats = function () {\n    return {\n      name: {},\n\n    setDefaultConfig: function (config) {\n      this._defaultConfig = config;\n    },\n\n    get: function (name) {\n      if (!this._breakers[name]) {\n        this._breakers[name] = new     }\n    },\n\n    setOnline: function (online) {\n      var wasOffline = !this._online;\n      this._online = online;\n\n      if (online && wasOffline && this._queue.length > 0) {\n `lib/packages/plugin_engine/lib/src/lazy_plugin_loader.dart`\n\n```dart\nimport 'dart:async';\n\nimport 'package:sweetmelon/packages/core/lib/core.dart';\nimport 'plugin_interface.dart';\nimport 'plugin_registry.dart';\n\n/// Factory function for creating plugin instances\ntypedef PluginFactory = Plugin Function();\n\n/// تعریف یک پلاگین lazy\nclass LazyPluginDefinition {\n  final String id;\n  final String version;\n  final PluginFactory factory;\n  final bool autoInitialize;\n  final List<String> dependencies;\n\n  const LazyPluginDefinition({\n    required this.id,\n    required this.version,\n    required this.factory,\n    this.autoInitialize = false,\n    this.dependencies = const [],\n  });\n}\n\n/// وضعیت یک پلاگین lazy\nenum LazyPluginState {\n  unloaded,\n  loading,\n LazyPluginStatus({\n    required this.id,\n    required this.state,\n    this.loadedAt,\n    this.loadDuration,\n    this.error,\n  });\n\n  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {\n        'id': id,\n        'state': state.name,\n        'loadedAt': loadedAt?.toIso8601String(),\n        'loadDurationMs': loadDuration?.inMilliseconds,\n        if (error != null) 'error': error,\n      };\n}\n\nclass LazyPluginLoader {\n  final PluginRegistry registry;\n  final Map<String, LazyPluginDefinition> _definitions = {};\n  final Map<String, LazyPluginStatus> _statuses = {};\n  final Map<String, Completer<Plugin>> _loadingCompleters = {};\n\n  LazyPluginLoader({required this.registry});\n\n  /// ثبت یک پلاگین به صورت lazy\n  void register(LazyPluginDefinition definition) {\n    _definitions[definition.id] = definition;\n    _statuses[definition.id] = LazyPluginStatus(\n      id: definition.id,\n      state: LazyPluginState.unloaded,\n    );\n\n    BridgeLogger.debug(\n      'LazyLoader',\n      'Registered lazy plugin: ${definition.id}@${definition.version}',\n    );\n  }\n\n  /// ثبت چندین پلاگین\n  void registerAll(List<LazyPluginDefinition> definitions) {\n    for (final def in definitions) {\n      register(def);\n    }\n  }\n\n  /// آیا این پلاگین قابل load شدن هست؟\n  bool canLoad(String pluginId) {\n    return _definitions.containsKey(pluginId);\n  }\n\n  /// آیا پلاگین load شده؟\n  bool isLoaded(String pluginId) {\n    return _statuses[pluginId]?.state == LazyPluginState.loaded;\n  }\n\n  /// بارگذاری یک پلاگین\n  Future<Plugin> load(String pluginId) async {\n    // اگه قبلاً load شده، از registry برگردون\n    final existing = registry.resolve(pluginId);\n    if (existing != null && existing.isReady) {\n      return existing;\n    }\n\n    // اگه در حال load شدن هست، منتظر بمون\n    if (_loadingCompleters.containsKey(pluginId)) {\n      BridgeLogger.debug(\n        'LazyLoader',\n        'Already loading: $pluginId, waiting...',\n      );\n      return _loadingCompleters[pluginId]!.future;\n    }\n\n    final definition = _definitions[pluginId];\n    if (definition == null) {\n      throw StateError(\n        'Plugin \"$pluginId\" is not registered as lazy plugin',\n      );\n    }\n\n    // شروع loading\n    final completer = Completer<Plugin>();\n    _loadingCompleters[pluginId] = completer;\n\n    _statuses[pluginId] = LazyPluginStatus(\n      id: pluginId,\n      state: LazyPluginState.loading,\n    );\n\n    final stopwatch = Stopwatch()..start();\n\n    try {\n      BridgeLogger.info('LazyLoader', 'Loading plugin: $pluginId');\n\n      // اول dependency ها رو load کن\n      for (final depId in definition.dependencies) {\n        if (!isLoaded(depId) && canLoad(depId)) {\n          BridgeLogger.debug(\n            'LazyLoader',\n            'Loading dependency: $depId for $pluginId',\n          );\n          await load(depId);\n        }\n      }\n\n      // ساخت instance\n      final plugin = definition.factory();\n\n      // ثبت در registry\n      await registry.register(plugin);\n\n      stopwatch.stop();\n\n      _statuses[pluginId] = LazyPluginStatus(\n        id: pluginId,\n        state: LazyPluginState.loaded,\n        loadedAt: DateTime.now(),\n        loadDuration: stopwatch.elapsed,\n      );\n\n      BridgeLogger.info(\n        'LazyLoader',\n        'Plugin loaded: $pluginId (${stopwatch.elapsedMilliseconds}ms)',\n      );\n\n      completer.complete(plugin);\n      return plugin;\n    } catch (e, stackTrace) {\n      stopwatch.stop();\n\n      _statuses[pluginId] = LazyPluginStatus(\n        id: pluginId,\n        state: LazyPluginState.failed,\n        error: e.toString(),\n      );\n\n      BridgeLogger.error(\n        'LazyLoader',\n        'Failed to load plugin: $pluginId — $e',\n      );\n\n      completer.completeError(e, stackTrace);\n      rethrow;\n    } finally {\n      _loadingCompleters.remove(pluginId);\n    }\n  }\n\n  ///   id: pluginId,\n      state: LazyPluginState.unloaded,\n    );\n\n    BridgeLogger.info('LazyLoader', 'Unloaded plugin: $pluginId');\n  }\n\n  /// Reload کردن پلاگین\n  Future<Plugin> reload(String pluginId) async {\n    BridgeLogger.info('LazyLoader', 'Reloading plugin: $pluginId');\n    await unload(pluginId);\n    return load(pluginId);\n  }\n\n  /// Load کردن همه پلاگین‌هایی که autoInitialize دارن\n  Future<void> loadAutoInitPlugins() async {\n    final autoPlugins = _definitions.values\n        .where((d) => d.autoInitialize)\n        .toList();\n\n    BridgeLogger.info(\n      'LazyLoader',\n      'Auto-loading ${autoPlugins.length} plugins',\n    );\n\n    for (final def in autoPlugins) {\n      try {\n        await load(def.id);\n      } catch (e) {\n        BridgeLogger.error(\n          'LazyLoader',\n          'Failed to auto-load: ${def.id} — $e',\n        );\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  /// Load کردن لیستی از پلاگین‌ها به صورت parallel\n  Future<List<Plugin>> loadMany(List<String> pluginIds) async {\n    final futures = pluginIds.map((id) async {\n      try {\n        return await load(id);\n      } catch (e) {\n        BridgeLogger.error('LazyLoader', 'Failed to load: $id — $e');\n        return null;\n      }\n    }).toList();\n\n    final results = await Future.wait(futures);\n    return results.whereType<Plugin>().toList();\n  }\n\n  /// Preload بدون block کردن\n  void preload(List<String> pluginIds) {\n    for (final id in pluginIds) {\n      if (!isLoaded(id) && canLoad(id)) {\n        load(id).catchError((e) {\n          BridgeLogger.warn('LazyLoader', 'Preload failed: $id — $e');\n        });\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  /// وضعیت همه پلاگین‌ها\n  Map<String, LazyPluginStatus> LazyPluginState.unloaded)\n      .map((e) => e.key)\n      .toList();\n\n  /// لیست پلاگین‌های loaded\n  List<String> get loadedPlugins => _statuses.entries\n      .where((e) => e.value.state == LazyPluginState.loaded)\n      .map((e) => e.key)\n      .toList();\n\n  /// آمار\n  Map<String, dynamic> get stats => {\n        'total': _definitions.length,\n        'loaded': loadedPlugins.length,\n        'unloaded': unloadedPlugins.length,\n        'loading': _loadingCompleters.length,\n        'plugins': _statuses.map(\n          (key, value) => MapEntry(key, value.toJson()),\n        ),\n      };\n\n  Future<void> dispose() async {\n    for (final id in loadedPlugins) {\n      await unload(id);\n    }\n    _definitions.clear();\n    _statuses.clear();\n  }\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n### 📄 بروزرسانی `lib/packages/plugin_engine/lib/plugin_engine.dart`\n\n```dart\nlibrary plugin_engine;\n\nexport 'src/plugin_interface.dart';\nexport   );\n          }\n        }\n      }\n\n      if (plugin == null) {\n        return _errorResponse(\n          request.requestId,\n          PluginErrorCode.pluginNotFound,\n          'Plugin  request.requestId,\n          PluginErrorCode.invalidArgs,\n          validation.errorMessage ?? cacheManager.invalidatePlugin(request.plugin);\n      }\n\n      _recordStats(request.plugin, request.method, processingTime, false);\n\n      _emitTrace(\n        traceId: traceId,\n        requestId: request.requestId,\n        plugin: request.plugin,\n        method: request.method,\n        processingTimeMs: processingTime,\n        success: true,\n      );\n\n      return PluginResponse.success(\n        requestId: request.requestId,\n        data: result,\n        metadata: ResponseMetadata(\n          processingTimeMs: processingTime,\n          pluginVersion: plugin.version,\n          fromCache: false,\n        ),\n      );\n    } on CircuitBreakerOpenException catch (e) {\n      return _errorResponse(\n        request.requestId,\n        PluginErrorCode.executionError,\n        e.toString(),\n      );\n    } catch (e, stackTrace) {\n      final processingTime =\n          DateTime.now().difference(startTime).inMilliseconds;\n\n      _emitTrace(\n        traceId: traceId,\n        requestId: request.requestId,\n        plugin: request.plugin,\n        method: request.method,\n        processingTimeMs: processingTime,\n        success: false,\n        error: e.toString(),\n      );\n\n      if (e is TimeoutException) {\n        return _errorResponse(\n          request.requestId,\n          PluginErrorCode.timeout,\n          'Plugin execution timed out',\n        );\n      }\n\n      return _errorResponse(\n        request.requestId,\n        PluginErrorCode.executionError,\n        e.toString(),\n        stackTrace: stackTrace.toString(),\n      );\n    }\n  }\n\n  Future<List<PluginResponse>> executeBatch(\n    List<PluginRequest> requests,\n    BatchOptions options,\n  ) async {\n    if (options.parallel) {\n      final futures = requests.map((request) async {\n        try {\n          return await execute(request);\n        } catch (e) {\n          return PluginResponse.failure(\n            requestId: request.requestId,\n            error: PluginError(\n              code: PluginErrorCode.executionError,\n              message: e.toString(),\n            ),\n          );\n        }\n      }).toList();\n\n      final results = await Future.wait(futures);\n\n      if (options.stopOnError) {\n        final firstError = results.indexWhere((r) => !r.success);\n        if (firstError >= 0) {\n          return results.sublist(0, firstError + 1);\n        }\n      }\n\n      return results;\n    } else {\n      final responses = <PluginResponse>[];\n      for (final request in requests) {\n        final response = await execute(request);\n        responses.add(response);\n        if (options.stopOnError && !response.success) break;\n      }\n      return responses;\n    }\n  }\n\n  Map<String, dynamic> get circuitBreakerStats => circuitBreakers.allStats;\n  void resetCircuitBreaker(String plugin) => circuitBreakers.reset(plugin);\n  void resetAllCircuitBreakers() => circuitBreakers.resetAll();\n\n  PluginResponse _errorResponse(\n    String requestId,\n    PluginErrorCode code,\n    String message, {\n    String? stackTrace,\n  }) {\n    return PluginResponse.failure(\n      requestId: requestId,\n      error: PluginError(\n        code: code,\n        message: message,\n        stackTrace: stackTrace,\n      ),\n    );\n  }\n\n  String _buildCacheKey(PluginRequest request) {\n    final sortedArgs = _sortedJsonEncode(request.args);\n    return '${request.plugin}:${request.method}:$sortedArgs';\n  }\n\n  String _sortedJsonEncode(Map<String, dynamic> map) {\n    final sortedKeys = map.keys.toList()..sort();\n    final sortedMap = <String, dynamic>{};\n    for (final key in sortedKeys) {\n      final value = map[key];\n      if (value is Map<String, dynamic>) {\n        sortedMap[key] = jsonDecode(_sortedJsonEncode(value));\n      } else {\n        sortedMap[key] = value;\n      }\n    }\n    return jsonEncode(sortedMap);\n  }\n\n  void _recordStats(String plugin, String method, int timeMs, bool fromCache) {\n    final key = '$plugin.$method';\n    _stats[key] ??= PluginStats(plugin: plugin, method: method);\n    _stats[key]!.record(timeMs, fromCache);\n  }\n\n  void _emitTrace({\n    required String traceId,\n    required String requestId,\n    required String plugin,\n    required String method,\n    required int processingTimeMs,\n    required bool success,\n    bool fromCache = false,\n    String? error,\n  }) {\n    if (!_traceController.isClosed) {\n      _traceController.add(PluginTrace(\n        traceId: traceId,\n        requestId: requestId,\n        plugin: plugin,\n        method: method,\n        processingTimeMs: processingTimeMs,\n        success: success,\n        fromCache: fromCache,\n        error: error,\n      ));\n    }\n  }\n\n  Map<String, PluginStats> get stats => Map.unmodifiable(_stats);\n\n  void dispose() {\n    _disposed = true;\n    if (!_traceController.isClosed) {\n      _traceController.close();\n    }\n  }\n}\n\nclass PluginStats {\n  final String plugin;\n  final String method;\n  int totalCalls = 0;\n  int cacheHits = 0;\n  int totalTimeMs = 0;\n  int errorCount = 0;\n\n  PluginStats({required this.plugin, required this.method});\n\n  void record(int timeMs, bool fromCache) {\n    totalCalls++;\n    totalTimeMs += timeMs;\n    if (fromCache) cacheHits++;\n  }\n\n  void recordError() => errorCount++;\n  double get avgTimeMs => totalCalls > 0 ? totalTimeMs / totalCalls : 0;\n  double get cacheHitRate => totalCalls > 0 ? cacheHits / totalCalls : 0;\n\n  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {\n        'plugin': plugin,\n        'method': method,\n        'totalCalls': totalCalls,\n        'cacheHits': cacheHits,\n        'cacheHitRate': cacheHitRate,\n        'avgTimeMs': avgTimeMs,\n        'errorCount': errorCount,\n      };\n}\n\nclass PluginTrace {\n  final String traceId;\n  final String requestId;\n  final String plugin;\n  final String method;\n  final int processingTimeMs;\n  final bool success;\n  final bool fromCache;\n  final String? error;\n  final DateTime timestamp;\n\n  PluginTrace({\n    required this.traceId,\n    required this.requestId,\n    required this.plugin,\n    required this.method,\n    required this.processingTimeMs,\n    required this.success,\n    this.fromCache = false,\n    this.error,\n  }) : timestamp = DateTime.now();\n\n  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {\n        'traceId': traceId,\n        'requestId': requestId,\n        'plugin': plugin,\n        'method': method,\n        'processingTimeMs': processingTimeMs,\n        'success': success,\n        'fromCache': fromCache,\n        if (error != null) 'error': error,\n        'timestamp': timestamp.toIso8601String(),\n      };\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n## بخش ۳: بروزرسانی Service Locator با Lazy Loading\n\n### 📄 `lib/di/service_locator.dart`\n\n> فقط بخش تغییر test('blocks calls exceeding limit', () async {\n      limiter.addRule('test', RateLimitRule.perSecond(3));\n\n      for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {\n        await limiter.check('test', 'method');\n      }\n\n      final result = await limiter.check('test', 'method');\n      expect(result.allowed, false);\n      expect(result.remaining, 0);\n      expect(result.retryAfterMs, greaterThan(0));\n DateTime.now();\n    taskState.runCount++;\n\n    _emitEvent('task.started', {\n      'taskId': taskId,\n      'action': action,\n      'runCount': taskState.runCount,\n    });\n\n    final stopwatch = Stopwatch()..start();\n\n    try {\n      // اجرای task بر اساس action type\n      dynamic result;\n\n      switch (action) {\n        case 'httpSync':\n          result = await _executeHttpSync(params, timeoutMs);\n          break;\n        case 'storageCleanup':\n          result = await _executeStorageCleanup(params);\n          break;\n        case 'cacheCleanup':\n          result = await _executeCacheCleanup(params);\n          break;\n        case 'compute':\n          result = await _executeCompute(params, timeoutMs);\n          break;\n        default:\n          // Custom action — result comes from params\n          result = {\n            'action': action,\n            'params': params,\n            'executedAt': DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),\n          };\n      }\n\n      stopwatch.stop();\n\n      taskState.status = TaskStatus.completed;\n      taskState.lastDuration = stopwatch.elapsed;\n      taskState.lastResult = result;\n      taskState.lastError = null;\n\n      _emitEvent('task.completed', {\n        'taskId': taskId,\n        'durationMs': stopwatch.elapsedMilliseconds,\n        'result': result,\n      });\n\n      return {\n        'taskId': taskId,\n        'completed': true,\n        'durationMs': stopwatch.elapsedMilliseconds,\n        'result': result,\n      };\n    } catch (e) {\n      stopwatch.stop();\n\n      taskState.status = TaskStatus.failed;\n      taskState.lastDuration = stopwatch.elapsed;\n      taskState.lastError = e.toString();\n\n      BridgeLogger.error('BackgroundTask', '[$taskId] Failed: $e');\n\n      _emitEvent('task.failed', {\n        'taskId': taskId,\n        'error': e.toString(),\n        'durationMs': stopwatch.elapsedMilliseconds,\n      });\n\n      return {\n        'taskId': taskId,\n        'completed': false,\n        'error': e.toString(),\n      };\n    }\n  }\n\n  Map<String, dynamic> _startRepeating(Map<String, dynamic> args) {\n    final taskId = args['taskId'] as String;\n    final intervalMs = (args['intervalMs'] as num).toInt();\n    final action = args['action'] as String? ?? 'execute';\n    final params = (args['params'] as Map<String, dynamic>?) ?? {};\n    final immediate = args['immediate'] as bool? ?? true;\n\n    // Cancel existing timer\n    _timers[taskId]?.cancel();\n\n    // Auto-register if needed\n    if (!_taskStates.containsKey(taskId)) {\n      _register({'taskId': taskId, 'name': taskId});\n    }\n\n    final taskState = _taskStates[taskId]!;\n    taskState.nextRunAt = DateTime.now().add(\n      Duration(milliseconds: intervalMs),\n    );\n\n    _timers[taskId] = Timer.periodic(\n      Duration(milliseconds: intervalMs),\n      (_) {\n        _runOnce({\n          'taskId': taskId,\n          'action': action,\n          'params': params,\n        });\n\n        taskState.nextRunAt = DateTime.now().add(\n          Duration(milliseconds: intervalMs),\n        );\n      },\n    );\n\n    BridgeLogger.info(\n      'BackgroundTask',\n      '[$taskId] Repeating every ${intervalMs}ms',\n    );\n\n    // Run immediately if requested\n    if (immediate) {\n      _runOnce({\n        'taskId': taskId,\n        'action': action,\n        'params': params,\n      });\n    }\n\n    return {\n      'taskId': taskId,\n      'repeating': true,\n      'intervalMs': intervalMs,\n    };\n  }\n\n  Map<String, dynamic> _stop(Map<String, dynamic> args) {\n    final taskId = args['taskId'] as String;\n\n    _timers[taskId]?.cancel();\n    _timers.remove(taskId);\n\n    final state = _taskStates[taskId];\n    if (state != null) {\n      state.status = TaskStatus.cancelled;\n      state.nextRunAt = null;\n    }\n\n    return {'taskId': taskId, 'stopped': true};\n  }\n\n  Map<String, dynamic> _stopAll() {\n    final count = _timers.length;\n\n    for (final timer in _timers.values) {\n      timer.cancel();\n    }\n    _timers.clear();\n\n    for (final state in _taskStates.values) {\n      if (state.status == TaskStatus.running) {\n        state.status = TaskStatus.cancelled;\n      }\n      state.nextRunAt = null;\n    }\n\n    return {'stopped': count};\n  }\n\n  Map<String, dynamic> _getTaskState(Map<String, dynamic> args) {\n    final taskId = args['taskId'] as String;\n    final state = _taskStates[taskId];\n\n    if (state == null) {\n      return {'taskId': taskId, 'found': false};\n    }\n\n    return {\n      'found': true,\n      ...state.toJson(),\n      'hasTimer': _timers.containsKey(taskId),\n    };\n  }\n\n  Map<String, dynamic> _getAllTasks() {\n    return {\n      'tasks': _taskStates.values.map((s) => {\n            ...s.toJson(),\n            'hasTimer': _timers.containsKey(s.id),\n          }).toList(),\n      'count': _taskStates.length,\n      'runningTimers': _timers.length,\n    };\n  }\n\n  // ── Built-in task executors ──\n\n  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> _executeHttpSync(\n    Map<String, dynamic> params,\n    int timeoutMs,\n  ) async {\n    // این task داده‌ها رو از یه URL می‌خونه و sync می‌کنه\n    final url = params['url'] as String?;\n    if (url == null) {\n      return {'synced': false, 'reason': 'no_url'};\n    }\n\n    BridgeLogger.info('BackgroundTask', 'HTTP Sync: $url');\n\n    // در عمل اینجا باید از HTTP plugin استفاده بشه\n    // ولی چون داخل همین Dart هستیم:\n    return {\n      'synced': true,\n      'url': url,\n      'timestamp': DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),\n    };\n  }\n\n  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> _executeStorageCleanup(\n    Map<String, dynamic> params,\n  ) async {\n    final olderThanDays = (params['olderThanDays'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 30;\n\n    BridgeLogger.info(\n      'BackgroundTask',\n      'Storage cleanup: older than $olderThanDays days',\n    );\n\n    return {\n      'cleaned': true,\n      'olderThanDays': olderThanDays,\n      'timestamp': DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),\n    };\n  }\n\n  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> _executeCacheCleanup(\n    Map<String, dynamic> params,\n  ) async {\n    BridgeLogger.info('BackgroundTask', 'Cache cleanup');\n\n    return {\n      'cleaned': true,\n      'timestamp': DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),\n    };\n  }\n\n  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> _executeCompute(\n    Map<String, dynamic> params,\n    int timeoutMs,\n  ) async {\n    // اجرای یک محاسبه سنگین در isolate جداگانه\n    final expression = params['expression'] as String?;\n    final data = params['data'];\n\n    if (expression == null) {\n      return {'computed': false, 'reason': 'no_expression'};\n    }\n\n    try {\n      final result = await Isolate.run(() {\n        // محاسبه ساده — در عمل می‌شه پیچیده‌تر باشه\n        return {\n          'expression': expression,\n          'data': data,\n          'result': 'computed',\n          'timestamp': DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),\n        };\n      }).timeout(Duration(milliseconds: timeoutMs));\n\n      return {\n        'computed': true,\n        'result': result,\n      };\n    } on TimeoutException {\n      return {'computed': false, 'reason': 'timeout'};\n    }\n  }\n\n  void _emitEvent(String event, dynamic data) {\n    if (eventEmitter != null) {\n      eventEmitter!(event, data);\n    }\n  }\n\n  @override\n  Future<ValidationResult> validateArgs(\n    String method,\n    Map<String, dynamic> args,\n  ) async {\n    switch (method) {\n      case 'register':\n      case 'runOnce':\n      case 'stop':\n      case 'unregister':\n      case 'getTaskState':\n        final taskId = args['taskId'];\n        if (taskId is! String || taskId.isEmpty) {\n          return ValidationResult.invalid('taskId is required');\n        }\n        return ValidationResult.valid();\n\n      case 'startRepeating':\n        final taskId = args['taskId'];\n        if (taskId is! String || taskId.isEmpty) {\n          return ValidationResult.invalid('taskId is required');\n        }\n        final intervalMs = args['intervalMs'];\n        if (intervalMs is! num || intervalMs <= 0) {\n          return ValidationResult.invalid(\n            'intervalMs is required and must be a positive number',\n          );\n        }\n        if (intervalMs < 1000) {\n          return ValidationResult.invalid(\n            'intervalMs must be at least 1000ms',\n          );\n        }\n        return ValidationResult.valid();\n\n      default:\n        return ValidationResult.valid();\n    }\n  }\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n## 📄 `lib/plugins/background_task/pubspec.yaml`\n\n```yaml\nname: background_task_plugin\ndescription: Background task scheduler and executor Permission Plugin\n\nکاربرد:\nمدیریت مجوزها مثل دوربین، لوکیشن، فایل، میکروفون، نوتیفیکیشن و غیره.\nچرا اولویت بالا دارد:\nتقریبا همه APIهای نیتیو بدون مدیریت درست permission ناقص یا غیرقابل استفاده می‌شوند.\n2. App Lifecycle Plugin\n\nکاربرد:\nاطلاع به JS از وضعیت اپ مثل launch, pause, resume, background, foreground, terminate.\nچرا مهم است:\nبرای هماهنگی اپ وب با رفتار اپ نیتیو لازم است؛ مخصوصا برای حفظ state و توقف/ادامه عملیات.\n3. Device Info Plugin\n\nکاربرد:\nدریافت اطلاعات دستگاه مثل مدل، برند، نسخه Android، ABI، شناسه اپ، نسخه اپ، رزولوشن، زبان سیستم.\nچرا مهم است:\nبرای تصمیم‌گیری در JS، دیباگ، لاگ‌گیری، تحلیل خطا و شخصی‌سازی رفتار اپ.\n4. Connectivity / Network Status Plugin\n\nکاربرد:\nاطلاع از وضعیت اینترنت، نوع شبکه (Wi-Fi / Mobile / Offline) و تغییرات آن.\nچرا مهم است:\nهر اپ HTML واقعی باید بتواند offline/online بودن را مدیریت کند.\n5. Storage Plugin\n\nکاربرد:\nذخیره و خواندن key-value، cache، تنظیمات کاربر، session data.\nچرا مهم است:\nیکی از پایه‌ای‌ترین نیازهای هر اپ وب یا هیبریدی است.\n6. File System Plugin\n\nکاربرد:\nخواندن/نوشتن فایل، ساخت پوشه، لیست فایل‌ها، حذف فایل، دسترسی به دایرکتوری‌های امن اپ.\nچرا مهم است:\nبرای پروژه‌های واقعی، فقط key-value کافی نیست؛ فایل، cache، دانلود و export لازم می‌شود.\n7. HTTP / Native Request Plugin\n\nکاربرد:\nارسال درخواست شبکه از طریق لایه نیتیو، مدیریت timeout، هدرها، دانلود/آپلود، TLS بهتر.\nچرا مهم است:\nگاهی fetch داخل WebView محدودیت دارد یا نیاز به کنترل بیشتر در سطح نیتیو هست.\n8. Intent / Deep Link Plugin\n\nکاربرد:\nباز کردن URL، شماره تماس، ایمیل، اپ‌های دیگر، دریافت deep link و app link.\nچرا مهم است:\nبخش مهمی از تعامل Android با اپ‌های دیگر از طریق Intent انجام می‌شود.\n9. Clipboard Plugin\n\nکاربرد:\nخواندن و نوشتن clipboard.\nچرا مهم است:\nاستفاده زیاد در فرم‌ها، OTP، کپی لینک، متن، داده‌ها.\n10. Share Plugin\n\nکاربرد:\nاشتراک‌گذاری متن، لینک، عکس، فایل به اپ‌های دیگر.\nچرا مهم است:\nدر اغلب اپ‌ها نیاز رایج و پرتکرار است.\n2) پلاگین‌های ضروری برای تجربه کاربری کامل\n\nاین‌ها معمولا خیلی زود بعد از فاز اول لازم می‌شوند.\n11. Camera Plugin\n\nکاربرد:\nعکس گرفتن، فیلم‌برداری، انتخاب از دوربین.\nچرا مهم است:\nبرای فرم‌ها، احراز هویت، آپلود تصویر، اسناد، فروشگاهی و اجتماعی ضروری است.\n12. Gallery / Media Picker Plugin\n\nکاربرد:\nانتخاب عکس، ویدیو، فایل رسانه‌ای از گالری.\nچرا مهم است:\nبسیاری از پروژه‌ها نیاز دارند فایل را از دستگاه انتخاب کنند، نه فقط با دوربین بگیرند.\n13. Geolocation Plugin\n\nکاربرد:\nدریافت موقعیت، watch location، بررسی فعال بودن GPS، permission لوکیشن.\nچرا مهم است:\nبرای نقشه، سفارش، حمل‌ونقل، خدمات محلی، حضور و غیاب و ده‌ها سناریو لازم است.\n14. Notification Plugin\n\nکاربرد:\nنمایش نوتیفیکیشن محلی، مدیریت کانال‌ها، badge، tap action.\nچرا مهم است:\nبرای یادآوری، پیام، عملیات پس‌زمینه و تعامل کاربر بسیار مهم است.\n15. Push Notification Plugin\n\nکاربرد:\nدریافت push token، مدیریت اعلان‌های push، اکشن‌ها، داده‌های نوتیفیکیشن.\nچرا مهم است:\nبرای اپ‌های واقعی یکی از مهم‌ترین قابلیت‌هاست.\n16. Download / Upload Manager Plugin\n\nکاربرد:\nدانلود فایل، آپلود فایل، مشاهده پیشرفت، مدیریت صف دانلود، ادامه دانلود.\nچرا مهم است:\nدر اپ‌های واقعی خیلی زود نیاز می‌شود؛ مخصوصا وقتی JS به تنهایی کنترل کافی ندارد.\n17. Back Button / System Navigation Plugin\n\nکاربرد:\nمدیریت دکمه back، خروج از اپ، برگشت در router وب، کنترل رفتار سیستم.\nچرا مهم است:\nبرای پروژه‌های SPA مثل Angular/React بسیار مهم است تا navigation طبیعی شود.\n3) پلاگین‌های مهم برای تعامل با قابلیت‌های Android\n\nاین‌ها بسته به نوع محصول، خیلی ارزشمند می‌شوند.\n21. entities) {\n          if (entity is File) {\n            final stat = await entity.stat();\n            tempFreed += stat.size;\n            await entity.delete();\n          }\n        }\n      }\n _formatBytes(int bytes) {\n    if (bytes < 1024) return '${bytes}B';\n    if (bytes < 1048576) return '${(bytes / 1024).toStringAsFixed(1)}KB';\n    if (bytes < 1073741824) return '${(bytes / 1048576).toStringAsFixed(1)}MB';\n    return '${(bytes / 1073741824).toStringAsFixed(2)}GB';\n  }\n}\n```\n\n## 📄 `lib/plugins/cache_control/pubspec.yaml`\n\n```yaml\nname: cache_control_plugin\ndescription: WebView and app cache control plugin\nversion: 1.0.0\n\nenvironment:\n  sdk: ^3.0.0\n\ndependencies:\n  flutter:\n    sdk: flutter\n  plugin_engine:\n    path: `lib/plugins/app_update/lib/app_update_plugin.dart`\n\n```dart\nimport 'dart:async';\nimport 'dart:convert';\nimport 'dart:io';\n\nimport 'package:http/http.dart' as http;\nimport 'package:package_info_plus/package_info_plus.dart';\nimport 'package:url_launcher/url_launcher.dart';\nimport 'package:sweetmelon/packages/core/lib/core.dart';\nimport 'package:sweetmelon/packages/plugin_engine/lib/plugin_engine.dart';\n\ntypedef UpdateEventEmitter = Future<void> Function(String event, dynamic data);\n\nclass AppUpdatePlugin extends Plugin {\n  final UpdateEventEmitter? eventEmitter;\n\n  PackageInfo? _packageInfo;\n  Map<String, dynamic>? _lastCheckResult;\n\n  /// URL برای بررسی نسخه جدید — باید از طرف سرور شما ست بشه\n  String? _updateCheckUrl;\n\n  /// آدرس Play Store\n  String? _playStoreUrl;\n\n  AppUpdatePlugin({this.eventEmitter});\n\n  @override\n  String get name => 'appUpdate';\n\n  @override\n  String get version => '1.0.0';\n\n  @override\n  String get description => 'App version check and update plugin';\n\n  @override\n  List<String> get supportedMethods => [\n        'configure',\n        'getCurrentVersion',\n        'checkForUpdate',\n        'openStore',\n        'getLastCheckResult',\n        'getInfo',\n      ];\n\n  @override\n  Future<void> onInitialize() async {\n    _packageInfo = await PackageInfo.fromPlatform();\n  }\n\n  @override\n  Future<dynamic> onCall(String method, Map<String, dynamic> args) async {\n    switch (method) {\n      case 'configure':\n        return _configure(args);\n      case 'getCurrentVersion':\n        return _getCurrentVersion();\n      case 'checkForUpdate':\n        return _checkForUpdate(args);\n      case 'openStore':\n        return _openStore(args);\n      case 'getLastCheckResult':\n        return _lastCheckResult ?? {'checked': false};\n      case 'getInfo':\n        return {\n          'name': name,\n          'version': version,\n          'currentVersion': _packageInfo?.version,\n          'buildNumber': _packageInfo?.buildNumber,\n          'configured': _updateCheckUrl != null,\n        };\n      default:\n        throw UnsupportedError('Method \"$method\" not supported');\n    }\n  }\n\n  Map<String, dynamic> _configure(Map<String, dynamic> args) {\n    _updateCheckUrl = args['updateCheckUrl'] as String?;\n    _playStoreUrl = args['playStoreUrl'] as String?;\n\n    BridgeLogger.info('AppUpdate', 'Configured: url=$_updateCheckUrl');\n\n    return {\n      'configured': true,\n      'updateCheckUrl': _updateCheckUrl,\n      'playStoreUrl': _playStoreUrl,\n    };\n  }\n\n  Map<String, dynamic> _getCurrentVersion() {\n    return {\n      'version': _packageInfo?.version ?? 'unknown',\n      'buildNumber': _packageInfo?.buildNumber ?? 'unknown',\n      'packageName': _packageInfo?.packageName ?? 'unknown',\n      'appName': _packageInfo?.appName ?? 'unknown',\n    };\n  }\n\n  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> _checkForUpdate(\n    Map<String, dynamic> args,\n  ) async {\n    final checkUrl = args['url'] as String? ?? _updateCheckUrl;\n\n    if (checkUrl == null || checkUrl.isEmpty) {\n      // بدون URL سرور — فقط اطلاعات نسخه فعلی\n      _lastCheckResult = {\n        'checked': true,\n        'updateAvailable': false,\n        'reason': 'no_update_url_configured',\n        'currentVersion': _packageInfo?.version,\n      };\n      return _lastCheckResult!;\n    }\n\n    try {\n      final response = await http.get(\n        Uri.parse(checkUrl),\n        headers: {\n          'X-App-Version': _packageInfo?.version ?? '',\n          'X-Build-Number': _packageInfo?.buildNumber ?? '',\n          'X-Package-Name': _packageInfo?.packageName ?? '',\n          'X-Platform': Platform.operatingSystem,\n        },\n      ).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 10));\n\n      if (response.statusCode != 200) {\n        _lastCheckResult = {\n          'checked': true,\n          'updateAvailable': false,\n          'error': 'Server returned ${response.statusCode}',\n        };\n        return _lastCheckResult!;\n      }\n\n      final data = jsonDecode(response.body) as Map<String, dynamic>;\n      final latestVersion = data['latestVersion'] as String?;\n      final minVersion = data['minVersion'] as String?;\n      final storeUrl = data['storeUrl'] as String?;\n      final releaseNotes = data['releaseNotes'] as String?;\n      final forceUpdate = data['forceUpdate'] as bool? ?? false;\n\n      if (storeUrl != null) _playStoreUrl = storeUrl;\n\n      final currentVersion = _packageInfo?.version ?? '0.0.0';\n      final updateAvailable = latestVersion != null &&\n          _isNewerVersion(latestVersion, currentVersion);\n\n      final mustUpdate = minVersion != null &&\n          _isNewerVersion(minVersion, currentVersion);\n\n      _lastCheckResult = {\n        'checked': true,\n        'updateAvailable': updateAvailable,\n        'mustUpdate': mustUpdate || forceUpdate,\n        'currentVersion': currentVersion,\n        'latestVersion': latestVersion,\n        'minVersion': minVersion,\n        'releaseNotes': releaseNotes,\n        'storeUrl': storeUrl ?? _playStoreUrl,\n        'checkedAt': DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),\n      };\n\n      if (updateAvailable) {\n        eventEmitter?.call('appUpdate.available', _lastCheckResult);\n      }\n\n      return _lastCheckResult!;\n    } catch (e) {\n      BridgeLogger.error('AppUpdate', 'Check failed: $e');\n\n      _lastCheckResult = {\n        'checked': true,\n        'updateAvailable': false,\n        'error': e.toString(),\n      };\n\n      return _lastCheckResult!;\n    }\n  }\n\n  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> _openStore(Map<String, dynamic> args) async {\n    final url = args['url'] as String? ?? _playStoreUrl;\n\n    if (url == null || url.isEmpty) {\n      // Default Play Store URL\n      final packageName = _packageInfo?.packageName ?? '';\n      final defaultUrl =\n          'https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=$packageName';\n\n      final launched = await launchUrl(\n        Uri.parse(defaultUrl),\n        mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication,\n      );\n\n      return {'opened': launched, 'url': defaultUrl};\n    }\n\n    final launched = await launchUrl(\n      Uri.parse(url),\n      mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication,\n    );\n\n    return {'opened': launched, 'url': url};\n  }\n\n  bool _isNewerVersion(String newer, String current) {\n    final nParts = newer.split('.').map((p) => int.tryParse(p) ?? 0).toList();\n    final cParts = current.split('.').map((p) => int.tryParse(p) ?? 0).toList();\n\n    for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++) {\n      final n = i < nParts.length ? nParts[i] : 0;\n      final c = i < cParts.length ? cParts[i] : 0;\n      if (n > c) return true;\n      if (n < c) return false;\n    }\n\n    return false;\n  }\n}\n```\n\n## 📄 false, 'alarmId': alarmId};\n    }\n    return {'found': true, ...data, 'active': _alarms.containsKey(alarmId)};\n  }\n\n  Map<String, dynamic> _getAllAlarms() {\n    return {\n      'alarms': _alarmData.values.map((d) => {\n        ...d,\n        'active': _alarms.containsKey(d['alarmId']),\n      }).toList(),\n      'count': _alarmData.length,\n    };\n  }\n\n  @override\n  Future<ValidationResult> validateArgs(String method, Map<String, dynamic> args) async {\n    switch (method) {\n      case 'set':\n        if (args['delayMs'] == null && args['atMs'] == null) {\n }\n}\n```\n\n## 📄 `lib/plugins/alarm/pubspec.yaml`\n\n```yaml\nname: alarm_plugin\ndescription: Timer-based alarm plugin\nversion: 1.0.0\n\nenvironment:\n  sdk: ^3.0.0\n\ndependencies:\n  flutter:\n
