پلاگین‌ها\nclass PluginErrorHandler {\n  /// تبدیل هر exception به PluginError استاندارد\n  static PluginError fromException(Object error, [StackTrace? stackTrace]) {\n    if (error is PluginException) {\n      return PluginError(\n        code: error.code,\n        message: error.message,\n        details: error.details,\n        stackTrace: stackTrace?.toString(),\n      );\n    }\n\n    if (error is TimeoutException) {\n      return PluginError(\n        code: PluginErrorCode.timeout,\n        message: error.message ?? 'Operation timed out',\n        stackTrace: stackTrace?.toString(),\n      );\n    }\n\n    if (error is FormatException) {\n      return PluginError(\n        code: PluginErrorCode.invalidArgs,\n        message: 'Format error: ${error.message}',\n        stackTrace: stackTrace?.toString(),\n      );\n    }\n\n    if (error is StateError) {\n      return PluginError(\n        code: PluginErrorCode.executionError,\n        message: error.message,\n        stackTrace: stackTrace?.toString(),\n      );\n    }\n\n    if (error is UnsupportedError) {\n      return PluginError(\n        code: PluginErrorCode.methodNotFound,\n        message: error.message ?? 'Unsupported operation',\n        stackTrace: stackTrace?.toString(),\n      );\n    }\n\n    final message = error.toString();\n\n    // Network errors\n    if (_isNetworkError(message)) {\n      return PluginError(\n        code: PluginErrorCode.networkError,\n        message: message,\n        stackTrace: stackTrace?.toString(),\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Permission errors\n    if (_isPermissionError(message)) {\n      return PluginError(\n        code: PluginErrorCode.permissionDenied,\n        message: message,\n        stackTrace: stackTrace?.toString(),\n      );\n    }\n\n    return PluginError(\n      code: PluginErrorCode.executionError,\n      message: message,\n      stackTrace: stackTrace?.toString(),\n    );\n  }\n\n  /// ساخت response خطا از exception\n  static PluginResponse errorResponse(\n    String requestId,\n    Object error, [\n    StackTrace? stackTrace,\n  ]) {\n    return PluginResponse.failure(\n      requestId: requestId,\n      error: fromException(error, stackTrace),\n    );\n  }\n\n  /// اجرای یک action با error handling خودکار\n  static Future<PluginResponse> execute(\n    String requestId,\n    String pluginName,\n    String method,\n    Future<dynamic> Function() action,\n  ) async {\n    try {\n      final result = await action();\n      return PluginResponse.success(\n        requestId: requestId,\n        data: result,\n      );\n    } catch (e, stackTrace) {\n      BridgeLogger.error(\n        pluginName,\n        '$method error: $e',\n      );\n      return errorResponse(requestId, e, stackTrace);\n    }\n  }\n\n  static bool _isNetworkError(String message) {\n    final lower = message.toLowerCase();\n    return lower.contains('socketexception') ||\n        lower.contains('connection refused') ||\n        lower.contains('connection reset') ||\n        lower.contains('network is unreachable') ||\n        lower.contains('no address associated') ||\n        lower.contains('connection timed out');\n  }\n\n  static bool _isPermissionError(String message) {\n    final lower = message.toLowerCase();\n    return lower.contains('permission') ||\n        lower.contains('denied') ||\n        lower.contains('not allowed');\n  }\n}\n\n/// Exception سفارشی با error code\nclass PluginException implements Exception {\n  final PluginErrorCode code;\n  final String message;\n  final Map<String, dynamic>? details;\n\n  const PluginException({\n    required this.code,\n    required this.message,\n    this.details,\n  });\n\n  /// Factories for common errors\n  const PluginException.notFound(String what)\n      : code = PluginErrorCode.pluginNotFound,\n        message = '$what not found',\n        details = null;\n\n  const PluginException.invalidArgs(String reason)\n      : code = PluginErrorCode.invalidArgs,\n        message = reason,\n        details = null;\n\n  const PluginException.permissionDenied(String permission)\n      : code = PluginErrorCode.permissionDenied,\n        message = 'Permission denied: $permission',\n        details = null;\n\n  const PluginException.noContext()\n      : code = PluginErrorCode.executionError,\n        message = 'No UI context available',\n        details = null;\n\n  @override\n  String toString() => 'PluginException(${code.code}): $message';\n}\n\n/// Import helper\nclass TimeoutException `lib/plugins/wake_lock/lib/wake_lock_plugin.dart` — بازنویسی\n\n```dart\nimport 'package:flutter/services.dart';\nimport 'package:sweetmelon/packages/core/lib/core.dart';\nimport 'package:sweetmelon/packages/plugin_engine/lib/plugin_engine.dart';\n\nclass WakeLockPlugin extends BasePlugin {\n  bool _isLocked = false;\n  static const _channel = MethodChannel('sweetmelon/wake_lock');\n\n  @override\n  String get name => 'wakeLock';\n\n  @override\n  String get version => '1.0.0';\n\n  @override\n  String get description => 'Keep screen awake / wake lock plugin';\n\n  @override\n  List<String> get supportedMethods => [\n        'enable',\n        'disable',\n        'toggle',\n        'isEnabled',\n        'getInfo',\n      ];\n\n  @override\n  Future<dynamic> onCall(String method, Map<String, dynamic> args) async {\n    switch (method) {\n      case 'enable':\n        return _enable();\n      case 'disable':\n        return _disable();\n      case 'toggle':\n        return _isLocked ? _disable() : _enable();\n      case 'isEnabled':\n        return {'enabled': _isLocked};\n      case 'getInfo':\n        return {'name': name, 'version': version, 'enabled': _isLocked};\n      default:\n        throw UnsupportedError('Method \"$method\" not supported');\n    }\n  }\n\n  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> _enable() async {\n    if (_isLocked) {\n      return {'enabled': true, 'alreadyEnabled': true};\n    }\n\n    try {\n      await _channel.invokeMethod('enable');\n      _isLocked = true;\n      logInfo('Screen wake lock enabled (native)');\n      return {'enabled': true, 'alreadyEnabled': false, 'native': true};\n    } catch (e) {\n      logWarn('Native wake lock failed, using fallback: $e');\n      _isLocked = true;\n      return {'enabled': true, 'native': false, 'fallback': true};\n    }\n  }\n\n  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> _disable() async {\n    if (!_isLocked) {\n      return {'enabled': false, 'alreadyDisabled': true};\n    }\n\n    try {\n      await _channel.invokeMethod('disable');\n    } catch (_) {}\n\n    _isLocked = false;\n    logInfo('Screen wake lock disabled');\n    return {'enabled': false, 'alreadyDisabled': false};\n  }\n\n  @override\n  Future<void> onDispose() async {\n    if (_isLocked) await _disable();\n  }\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n## بخش ۶: تست Unit برای MessageSigner({\n    this.level = SecurityLevel.tokenOnly,\n    this.maxMessageAge = const Duration(seconds: 30),\n    int maxNonceHistory = 10000,\n  }) : _maxNonceHistory = maxNonceHistory;\n\n  /// _usedNonces.removeAll(\n          _usedNonces.take(toRemove).toList(),\n        );\n      }\n    }\n\n    return const ValidationResult(valid: true);\n  }\n\n  /// تولید signature برای response\n String secretKey,\n  ) {\n    // حذف فیلدهای امنیتی قبل از signing\n    final cleaned = Map<String, dynamic>.from(message)\n      ..remove('_signature')\n      ..remove('_token');\n\n    final BridgeAuth(),\n        signer = signer ?? MessageSigner(),\n        sslPinning = sslPinning ?? SslPinning(),\n        csp = csp ?? ContentSecurityPolicy.development(),\n        antiTampering = antiTampering ?? AntiTampering();\n\n  /// Production configuration\n  factory SecurityManager.production() {\n    return SecurityManager(\n      auth: BridgeAuth(sessionTimeout: const Duration(hours: 8)),\n      signer: MessageSigner(\n        level: SecurityLevel.signed,\n        maxMessageAge: const Duration(seconds: 30),\n      ),\n      sslPinning: SslPinning()..enable(),\n      csp: ContentSecurityPolicy.production(),\n      antiTampering: AntiTampering()..enable(),\n    );\n  }\n\n  /// Development configuration\n  factory SecurityManager.development() {\n    return SecurityManager(\n      auth: BridgeAuth(sessionTimeout: const Duration(hours: 24)),\n      signer: MessageSigner(level: SecurityLevel.tokenOnly),\n      sslPinning: SslPinning(),\n      csp: ContentSecurityPolicy.development(),\n      antiTampering: AntiTampering(),\n    );\n  }\n\n  /// شروع session و تولید JS injection code\n  String initializeSession() {\n    final token = auth.createSession();\n    _initialized = true;\n\n    BridgeLogger.info('SecurityManager', 'Session initialized');\n\n    return token;\n  }\n\n  /// اعتبارسنجی یک پیام ورودی\n  SecurityCheckResult validateIncomingMessage(\n    Map<String, dynamic> message,\n  ) {\n    // 1. بررسی payload size\n    final payloadSize = utf8.encode(jsonEncode(message)).length;\n    if (!csp.isPayloadSizeAllowed(payloadSize)) {\n      return SecurityCheckResult.rejected('payload_too_large');\n    }\n\n    // 2. بررسی token\n    final token = message['_token'] as String?;\n    if (!auth.validateToken(token)) {\n      return SecurityCheckResult.rejected('invalid_token');\n    }\n\n    // 3. بررسی signature\n    if (signer.level.index >= SecurityLevel.signed.index) {\n      final signature = message['_signature'] as String?;\n      final secretKey = auth.secretKey;\n\n      if (secretKey != null) {\n        final validationResult = signer.validate(\n          message,\n          token,\n          signature,\n          secretKey,\n          auth.currentToken!,\n        );\n\n        if (!validationResult.valid) {\n          return SecurityCheckResult.rejected(\n            validationResult.reason ?? 'signature_invalid',\n          );\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 4. بررسی plugin access\n    final plugin = message['plugin'] as String?;\n    if (plugin != null && !csp.isPluginAllowed(plugin)) {\n      return SecurityCheckResult.rejected('plugin_blocked');\n    }\n\n    return SecurityCheckResult.allowed();\n  }\n\n  /// تولید JS code برای injection امنیت\n  String generateSecurityScript() {\n    final token = auth.currentToken ?? '';\n    final secret = auth.secretKey ?? '';\n    final level = signer.level.name;\n\n    return '''\n      (function() {\n        window.__bridgeSecurity = {\n          token: \"$token\",\n          secret: \"$secret\",\n          level: \"$level\",\n          \n          sign: function(message) {\n            if (this.level === 'none' || this.level === 'tokenOnly') {\n              return null;\n            }\n            \n            var cleaned = {};\n            Object.keys(message).sort().forEach(function(key) {\n              if (key !== '_signature' && key !== '_token') {\n                cleaned[key] = message[key];\n              }\n            });\n            \n            var payload = JSON.stringify(cleaned);\n            // Simple HMAC - در production باید از crypto API استفاده بشه\n            return this._hmac(payload, this.secret);\n          },\n          \n          _hmac: function(message, key) {\n            // Simplified - for production use SubtleCrypto\n            var hash = 0;\n            var combined = key + message;\n            for (var i = 0; i < combined.length; i++) {\n              var char = combined.charCodeAt(i);\n              hash = ((hash << 5) - hash) + char;\n              hash = hash & hash;\n            }\n            return Math.abs(hash).toString(36);\n          },\n          \n          prepareMessage: function(message) {\n            message._token = this.token;\n            \n            if (this.level === 'strict') {\n              message._ts = Date.now();\n              message._nonce = Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 16);\n            }\n            \n            if (this.level === 'signed' || this.level === 'strict') {\n              message._signature = this.sign(message);\n            }\n            \n            return message;\n          }\n        };\n        \n        // Override Native.call to add security\n        if (window.Native && window.Native.call) {\n          var originalCall = window.Native.call;\n          \n          window.Native.call = function(options) {\n            var message = {\n              plugin: options.plugin,\n              method: options.method,\n              args: options.args || {},\n              version: options.version || '1.0.0',\n              requestId: options.requestId,\n              timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n              metadata: options.metadata || { headers: {} }\n            };\n            \n            var secured = window.__bridgeSecurity.prepareMessage(message);\n            options._token = secured._token;\n            options._signature = secured._signature;\n            options._ts = secured._ts;\n            options._nonce = secured._nonce;\n            \n            return originalCall.call(window.Native, options);\n          };\n        }\n        \n        console.log('[Security] Bridge security initialized (level: ' + window.__bridgeSecurity.level + ')');\n      })();\n    ''';\n  }\n\n  /// گزارش امنیتی\n  Map<String, dynamic> getSecurityReport() {\n    return {\n      'initialized': _initialized,\n      'auth': auth.stats,\n      'signer': {\n        'level': signer.level.name,\n      },\n      'sslPinning': sslPinning.stats,\n      'csp': csp.stats,\n      'antiTampering': antiTampering.stats,\n    };\n  }\n\n  void dispose() {\n    auth.revokeSession();\n    signer.clearNonces();\n  }\n}\n\nclass SecurityCheckResult {\n  final bool allowed;\n  final String? rejectionReason;\n\n  const SecurityCheckResult._({\n    required this.allowed,\n    this.rejectionReason,\n  });\n\n  factory SecurityCheckResult.allowed() =>\n      const SecurityCheckResult._(allowed: true);\n\n  factory SecurityCheckResult.rejected(String reason) =>\n      SecurityCheckResult._(allowed: false, rejectionReason: reason);\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n## بخش ۷: بروزرسانی Exports\n\n### 📄 بروزرسانی `lib/packages/core/lib/core.dart`\n\n```dart\nlibrary core;\n\nexport |\n| **Message Signer** | `message_signer.dart` | HMAC-SHA256 signing، nonce، timestamp، anti-replay |\n| **SSL Pinning** | `ssl_pinning.dart` | Certificate pinning برای HTTP calls |\n| **CSP** | `content_security.dart` | URL filtering، plugin whitelist، payload size limit |\n| **Anti-Tampering** | `anti_tampering.dart` | SHA-256 hash verification فایل‌های www |\n| **Security Manager** | `security_manager.dart` | یکپارچه‌سازی همه سیستم‌ها |\n\n## سطوح امنیت\n\n| سطح | توضیح |\n|-----|-------|\n| `none` | بدون اعتبارسنجی |\n| `tokenOnly` | فقط token — پیش‌فرض development |\n| `signed` | token + HMAC signature |\n| `strict` | token + signature + timestamp + nonce (anti-replay) |\n\n## تست‌ها\n\n| فایل | تعداد |\n|------|-------|\n| `bridge_auth_test.dart` | 11 |\n| `message_signer_test.dart` | 7 |\n| `content_security_test.dart` | 10 |\n| `anti_tampering_test.dart` | 8 |\n| `security_manager_test.dart` | 8 |\n| **مجموع جدید** | **44** |\n| **مجموع کل تست‌ها** | _registeredTasks = [];\n  bool _initialized = false;\n  int _roundRobin = 0;\n\n  WorkerPool({this.poolSize = 2});\n\n  Future<void> initialize() async {\n    if (_initialized) return;\n\n    for (int i = 0; i < poolSize; i++) {\n      final worker = _Worker(id: i);\n      await worker.spawn();\n      _workers.add(worker);\n    }\n\n    _initialized = true;\n    BridgeLogger.info('WorkerPool', 'Pool initialized with $poolSize workers');\n  }\n\n  /// اجرای یک task در isolate\n  Future<R> compute<T, R>(\n    R Function(T input) task,\n    T input, {\n    Duration timeout = const Duration(seconds: 30),\n  }) async {\n    if (!_initialized) await initialize();\n\n    return Isolate.run(\n      () => task(input),\n      debugName: 'sweetmelon_worker',\n    ).timeout(timeout);\n  }\n\n  /// اجرای JSON processing سنگین\n  Future<dynamic> processJson(String jsonInput) async {\n    return compute(_parseJson, jsonInput);\n  }\n\n  /// اجرای encryption سنگین\n  Future<List<int>> processBytes(\n    List<int> Function(List<int>) processor,\n    List<int> bytes,\n  ) async {\n    return compute(processor, bytes);\n  }\n\n  static dynamic _parseJson(String json) {\n    // heavy JSON processing\n    return json.length;\n  }\n\n  void dispose() {\n    for (final worker in _workers) {\n      worker.dispose();\n    }\n    _workers.clear();\n    _initialized = false;\n  }\n\n  Map<String, dynamic> get stats => {\n        'poolSize': poolSize,\n        'initialized': _initialized,\n        'activeWorkers': _workers.where((w) => w.isActive).length,\n      };\n}\n\nclass _Worker {\n  final int id;\n  Isolate? _isolate;\n  bool isActive = false;\n\n  _Worker({required this.id});\n\n  Future<void> spawn() async {\n    isActive = true;\n  }\n\n  void dispose() {\n    _isolate?.kill(priority: Isolate.immediate);\n    _isolate = null;\n    isActive = false;\n  }\n}\n\n/// helper برای computations سنگین\nclass ComputeHelper {\n  /// JSON encode سنگین در isolate\n  static Future<String> encodeJsonHeavy(\n    Map<String, dynamic> data,\n  ) async {\n    return Isolate.run(\n      () => _encodeJson(data),\n      debugName: 'json_encoder',\n    );\n  }\n\n  /// JSON decode سنگین در isolate\n  static Future<Map<String, dynamic>> decodeJsonHeavy(\n    String json,\n  ) async {\n    return Isolate.run(\n      () => _decodeJson(json),\n      debugName: 'json_decoder',\n    );\n  }\n\n  static String _encodeJson(Map<String, dynamic> data) {\n    import 'dart:convert';\n    return jsonEncode(data);\n  }\n\n  static Map<String, dynamic> _decodeJson(String json) {\n    import 'dart:convert';\n    return jsonDecode(json) as Map<String, dynamic>;\n  }\n\n  /// پردازش batch در isolate\n  static Future<List<T>> processBatch<T>(\n    List<T> items,\n    T Function(T) processor,\n  ) async {\n    return Isolate.run(\n      () => items.map(processor).toList(),\n      debugName: 'batch_processor',\n    );\n  }\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n## بخش ۴: Memory Profiler\n\n### 📄 `lib/packages/core/lib/src/performance/memory_profiler.dart`\n\n```dart\nimport 'dart:async';\n\nimport '../utils/logger.dart';\n\nclass MemorySnapshot {\n  final DateTime timestamp;\n  final int activeCalls;\n  final int cachedItems;\n  final int activeStreams;\n  final int registeredPlugins;\n  final Map<String, dynamic> extra;\n\n  const MemorySnapshot({\n    required this.timestamp,\n    required this.activeCalls,\n    required this.cachedItems,\n    required this.activeStreams,\n    required this.registeredPlugins,\n    this.extra = const {},\n  });\n\n  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {\n        'timestamp': timestamp.toIso8601String(),\n        'activeCalls': activeCalls,\n        'cachedItems': cachedItems,\n        'activeStreams': activeStreams,\n        'registeredPlugins': registeredPlugins,\n        ...extra,\n      };\n}\n\nclass MemoryProfiler {\n  final Duration sampleInterval;\n  final int maxSnapshots;\n\n  Timer? _timer;\n  final List<MemorySnapshot> _snapshots = [];\n  final List<MemoryDataProvider> _providers = [];\n  bool _running = false;\n\n  MemoryProfiler({\n    this.sampleInterval = const Duration(seconds: 10),\n    this.maxSnapshots = 100,\n  });\n\n  void addProvider(MemoryDataProvider provider) {\n    _providers.add(provider);\n  }\n\n  void start() {\n    if (_running) return;\n    _running = true;\n\n    _timer = Timer.periodic(sampleInterval, (_) => _sample());\n    BridgeLogger.info('MemoryProfiler', 'Started profiling');\n  }\n\n  void stop() {\n    _timer?.cancel();\n    _timer = null;\n    _running = false;\n  }\n\n  void _sample() {\n    int activeCalls = 0;\n    int cachedItems = 0;\n    int activeStreams = 0;\n    int registeredPlugins = 0;\n    final extra = <String, dynamic>{};\n\n    for (final provider in _providers) {\n      try {\n        final data = provider.getMemoryData();\n        activeCalls += data['activeCalls'] as int? ?? 0;\n        cachedItems += data['cachedItems'] as int? ?? 0;\n        activeStreams += data['activeStreams'] as int? ?? 0;\n        registeredPlugins += data['registeredPlugins'] as int? ?? 0;\n\n        data.forEach((key, value) {\n          if (!['activeCalls', 'cachedItems', 'activeStreams',\n              'registeredPlugins'].contains(key)) {\n            extra[key] = value;\n          }\n        });\n      } catch (e) {\n        BridgeLogger.warn('MemoryProfiler', 'Provider error: $e');\n      }\n    }\n\n    final snapshot = MemorySnapshot(\n      timestamp: DateTime.now(),\n      activeCalls: activeCalls,\n      cachedItems: cachedItems,\n      activeStreams: activeStreams,\n      registeredPlugins: registeredPlugins,\n      extra: extra,\n    );\n\n    _snapshots.add(snapshot);\n\n    if (_snapshots.length > maxSnapshots) {\n      _snapshots.removeAt(0);\n    }\n\n    _detectAnomalies(snapshot);\n  }\n\n  void _detectAnomalies(MemorySnapshot snapshot) {\n    if (snapshot.activeCalls > 100) {\n      BridgeLogger.warn(\n        'MemoryProfiler',\n        'High active calls: ${snapshot.activeCalls}',\n      );\n    }\n\n    if (snapshot.cachedItems > 400) {\n      BridgeLogger.warn(\n        'MemoryProfiler',\n        'Cache near capacity: ${snapshot.cachedItems}/500',\n      );\n    }\n  }\n\n  List<MemorySnapshot> get snapshots => List.unmodifiable(_snapshots);\n\n  Map<String, dynamic> getSummary() {\n    if (_snapshots.isEmpty) return {'samples': 0};\n\n    final last = _snapshots.last;\n    final first = _snapshots.first;\n\n    final callsTrend = _snapshots.length > 1\n        ? last.activeCalls - first.activeCalls\n        : 0;\n\n    final avgCachedItems = _snapshots.isEmpty\n        ? 0\n        : _snapshots.map((s) => s.cachedItems).reduce((a, b) => a + b) ~/\n            _snapshots.length;\n\n    return {\n      'samples': _snapshots.length,\n      'running': _running,\n      'latest': last.toJson(),\n      'trends': {\n        'activeCalls': callsTrend >= 0 ? '+$callsTrend' : '$callsTrend',\n      },\n      'averages': {\n        'cachedItems': avgCachedItems,\n      },\n    };\n  }\n\n  void dispose() {\n    stop();\n    _snapshots.clear();\n    _providers.clear();\n  }\n}\n\nabstract class MemoryDataProvider {\n  Map<String, dynamic> getMemoryData();\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n## بخش ۵: Benchmark Suite\n\n### 📄 `lib/packages/core/lib/src/performance/benchmark_suite.dart`\n\n```dart\nimport 'dart:async';\n\nimport 'package:sweetmelon/packages/core/lib/core.dart';\n\nclass BenchmarkResult {\n  final String this.minDuration,\n    required this.maxDuration,\n    required this.avgMs,\n    required this.p50Ms,\n    required this.p95Ms,\n    required this.p99Ms,\n    required this.allDurations,\n  });\n\n  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {\n        'name': name,\n        'iterations': iterations,\n        'totalMs': totalDuration.inMilliseconds,\n        'minMs': minDuration.inMilliseconds,\n        'maxMs': maxDuration.inMilliseconds,\n        'avgMs': avgMs,\n        'p50Ms': p50Ms,\n        'p95Ms': p95Ms,\n        'p99Ms': p99Ms,\n      };\n\n  @override\n  String toString() =>\n      '[$name] avg=${avgMs.toStringAsFixed(2)}ms '\n      'p50=${p50Ms.toStringAsFixed(2)}ms '\n      'p95=${p95Ms.toStringAsFixed(2)}ms '\n      'p99=${p99Ms.toStringAsFixed(2)}ms '\n      '(${iterations}x)';\n}\n\nclass BenchmarkSuite {\n  final List<BenchmarkResult> _results = [];\n\n  /// اجرای یک benchmark\n  Future<BenchmarkResult> run(\n    String name,\n    Future<void> Function() action, {\n    int iterations = 100,\n    int warmup = 5,\n    bool verbose = true,\n  }) async {\n    BridgeLogger.info('Benchmark', 'Running: $name ($iterations iterations)');\n\n    // Warmup\n    for (int i = 0; i < warmup; i++) {\n      await action();\n    }\n\n    final durations = <Duration>[];\n\n    for (int i = 0; i < iterations; i++) {\n      final sw = Stopwatch()..start();\n      await action();\n      sw.stop();\n      durations.add(sw.elapsed);\n    }\n\n    final result = _computeResult(name, durations);\n    _results.add(result);\n\n    if (verbose) {\n      BridgeLogger.info('Benchmark', result.toString());\n    }\n\n    return result;\n  }\n\n  /// اجرای چند benchmark و مقایسه\n  Future<Map<String, BenchmarkResult>> compare(\n    Map<String, Future<void> Function()> benchmarks, {\n    int iterations = 100,\n  }) async {\n    final results = <String, BenchmarkResult>{};\n\n    for (final entry in benchmarks.entries) {\n      results[entry.key] = await run(\n        entry.key,\n        entry.value,\n        iterations: iterations,\n      );\n    }\n\n    _printComparison(results);\n    return results;\n  }\n\n  BenchmarkResult _computeResult(\n    String name,\n    List<Duration> durations,\n  ) {\n    if (durations.isEmpty) {\n      return BenchmarkResult(\n        name: name,\n        iterations: 0,\n        totalDuration: Duration.zero,\n        minDuration: Duration.zero,\n        maxDuration: Duration.zero,\n        avgMs: 0,\n        p50Ms: 0,\n        p95Ms: 0,\n        p99Ms: 0,\n        allDurations: [],\n      );\n    }\n\n    final sorted = List<Duration>.from(durations)\n      ..sort((a, b) => a.compareTo(b));\n\n    final totalMs = durations.fold<int>(\n      0,\n      (sum, d) => sum + d.inMicroseconds,\n    );\n\n    final avgMs = totalMs / durations.length / 1000.0;\n    final p50Ms = _percentile(sorted, 0.5).inMicroseconds / 1000.0;\n    final p95Ms = _percentile(sorted, 0.95).inMicroseconds / 1000.0;\n    final p99Ms = _percentile(sorted, 0.99).inMicroseconds / 1000.0;\n\n    return BenchmarkResult(\n      name: name,\n      iterations: durations.length,\n      totalDuration: Duration(microseconds: totalMs),\n      minDuration: sorted.first,\n      maxDuration: sorted.last,\n      avgMs: avgMs,\n      p50Ms: p50Ms,\n      p95Ms: p95Ms,\n      p99Ms: p99Ms,\n      allDurations: durations,\n    );\n  }\n\n  Duration _percentile(List<Duration> sorted, double p) {\n    final index = ((sorted.length - 1) * p).round();\n    return sorted[index];\n  }\n\n  void _printComparison(Map<String, BenchmarkResult> results) {\n    if (results.isEmpty) return;\n\n    final baseline = results.values.first;\n    BridgeLogger.info('Benchmark', '--- Comparison ---');\n\n    for (final entry in results.entries) {\n      final ratio = entry.value.avgMs / baseline.avgMs;\n      final symbol = ratio < 1 ? '🟢' : ratio < 1.5 ? '🟡' : '🔴';\n      BridgeLogger.info(\n        'Benchmark',\n        '$symbol ${entry.key}: ${entry.value.avgMs.toStringAsFixed(2)}ms '\n            '(${ratio.toStringAsFixed(2)}x)',\n      );\n    }\n  }\n\n  List<BenchmarkResult> get results => List.unmodifiable(_results);\n\n  Map<String, dynamic> getSummaryReport() {\n    return {\n      'totalBenchmarks': _results.length,\n      'benchmarks': _results.map((r) => r.toJson()).toList(),\n    };\n  }\n\n  void clear() => _results.clear();\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n## بخش ۶: بروزرسانی exports\n\n### 📄 بروزرسانی take(opts.retry || 3),\n        )\n      )\n    );\n  }\n\n  return obs;\n}\n\n// ── Connectivity Observable ──\n\nexport const connectivity$ = nativeEvent$<{\n  online: boolean;\n  primary: string;\n _getCurrentUser();\n  }\n\n  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> _sendEmailVerification() async {\n    try {\n      await _auth?.currentUser?.sendEmailVerification();\n      return {'success': true};\n    } on FirebaseAuthException catch (e) {\n      return _authError(e);\n    }\n  }\n\n  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> _signInWithCustomToken(\n    Map<String, dynamic> args,\n  ) async {\n    final token = args['token'] as String;\n    try {\n      final credential = await _auth?.signInWithCustomToken(token);\n      return {\n        'success': true,\n        'user': credential?.user != null ? _userToMap(credential!.user!) : null,\n      };\n    } on FirebaseAuthException catch (e) {\n      return _authError(e);\n    }\n  }\n\n  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> _getIdToken(Map<String, dynamic> args) async {\n    final forceRefresh = args['forceRefresh'] as bool? ?? false;\n    try {\n      final token = await _auth?.currentUser?.getIdToken(forceRefresh);\n      return {'token': token};\n    } catch (e) {\n      return {'token': null, 'error': e.toString()};\n    }\n  }\n\n  Map<String, dynamic> _userToMap(User user) {\n    return {\n      'uid': user.uid,\n      'email': user.email,\n      'emailVerified': user.emailVerified,\n      'displayName': user.displayName,\n      'photoURL': user.photoURL,\n      'phoneNumber': user.phoneNumber,\n      'isAnonymous': user.isAnonymous,\n      'creationTime': user.metadata.creationTime?.toIso8601String(),\n      'lastSignInTime': user.metadata.lastSignInTime?.toIso8601String(),\n      'providerData': user.providerData.map((p) => {\n            'uid': p.uid,\n            'email': p.email,\n            'displayName': p.displayName,\n            'photoURL': p.photoURL,\n            'providerId': p.providerId,\n            'phoneNumber': p.phoneNumber,\n          }).toList(),\n    };\n  }\n\n  Map<String, dynamic> _authError(FirebaseAuthException e) {\n    return {\n      'success': false,\n      'errorCode': e.code,\n      'errorMessage': _localizeError(e.code),\n      'originalMessage': e.message,\n    };\n  }\n\n  String _localizeError(String code) {\n    switch (code) {\n      case 'user-not-found':\n        return 'No user found with this email address.';\n      case 'wrong-password':\n        return 'Incorrect password.';\n      case 'email-already-in-use':\n        return 'This email is already registered.';\n      case 'weak-password':\n        return 'Password is too weak.';\n      case 'invalid-email':\n        return 'Invalid email address.';\n      case 'network-request-failed':\n        return 'Network error. Please check your connection.';\n      case 'too-many-requests':\n        return 'Too many attempts. Please try again later.';\n      case 'user-disabled':\n        return 'This account has been disabled.';\n      case 'requires-recent-login':\n        return 'Please sign in again to perform this action.';\n      case 'invalid-credential':\n        return 'Invalid credentials.';\n      default:\n        return 'Authentication error: $code';\n    }\n  }\n\n  @override\n  Future<ValidationResult> validateArgs(\n    String method,\n    Map<String, dynamic> args,\n  ) async {\n    switch (method) {\n      case 'signInWithEmail':\n      case 'signUpWithEmail':\n        if (args['email'] is! String || (args['email'] as String).isEmpty) {\n          return ValidationResult.invalid('email is required');\n        }\n        if (args['password'] is! String || (args['password'] as String).isEmpty) {\n          return ValidationResult.invalid('password is required');\n        }\n        return ValidationResult.valid();\n      case 'sendPasswordResetEmail':\n        if (args['email'] is! String) {\n          return ValidationResult.invalid('email is required');\n        }\n        return ValidationResult.valid();\n      default:\n        return ValidationResult.valid();\n    }\n  }\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n## بخش ۷: ثبت پلاگین‌های Firebase\n\n### 📄 `lib/di/service_locator.dart` — اضافه شده\n\n```dart\n// Firebase imports\nimport }).catch(function() {\n        setTimeout(connectToBridge, 2000);\n      });\n    }\n\n    function setupBridgeListeners() {\n      // Intercept Native.call\n      var originalCall = window.Native.call;\n      window.Native.call = function(options) {\n        var startTime = Date.now();\n        var id = 'msg_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 5);\n\n state.errorCount++;\n          state.pendingCount = Math.max(0, state.pendingCount - 1);\n          updateStats();\n          throw err;\n        });\n      };\n\n      // Listen to all events\n msg.error = error;\n      msg.durationMs = durationMs;\n      renderMessages();\n      if (state.selectedId === id) renderDetail();\n    }\n\n    function addEvent(evt) {\n }\n\n    // ── Render Messages ──\n    function renderMessages() {\n      var list = $('messageList');\n      var msgs = getFilteredMessages();\n\n      $('msgCount').textContent = msgs.length;\n\n      if (msgs.length === 0) {\n        list.innerHTML = '<div class=\"empty-state\"><div class=\"empty-icon\">📭</div><div class=\"empty-text\">No messages</div></div>';\n        return;\n      }\n\n      list.innerHTML = msgs.map(function(msg) {\n        var isErr = msg.status === 'error';\n        var icon = msg.direction === 'incoming' ?    '</div>'\n          ].join('');\n        }).join('')\n      ].join('');\n    }\n\n    function renderPluginFilters() {\n      var container = $('pluginFilterList');\n      var plugins = 'dart:async';\n\nimport 'package:sweetmelon/packages/core/lib/core.dart';\n\nclass PerformanceMetric {\n  final String name;\n  final String category;\n  final int durationMs;\n  final bool success;\n  final DateTime timestamp;\n  final Map<String, dynamic> extra;\n\n  const PerformanceMetric({\n    required this.name,\n    required this.category,\n    required this.durationMs,\n    required this.success,\n    required this.timestamp,\n    this.extra = const {},\n  });\n\n  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {\n        'name': name,\n        'category': category,\n        'durationMs': durationMs,\n        'success': success,\n        'timestamp': timestamp.toIso8601String(),\n        ...extra,\n      };\n}\n\nclass PerformanceAudit {\n  final List<PerformanceMetric> _metrics = [];\n  final int _maxMetrics;\n\n  PerformanceAudit({int maxMetrics = 1000}) : _maxMetrics = maxMetrics;\n\n  void record(PerformanceMetric metric) {\n    _metrics.add(metric);\n    if (_metrics.length > _maxMetrics) {\n      _metrics.removeAt(0);\n    }\n  }\n\n  Future<T> measure<T>({\n    required String name,\n    required String category,\n    required Future<T> Function() fn,\n  }) async {\n    final stopwatch = Stopwatch()..start();\n    bool success = true;\n\n    try {\n      final result = await fn();\n      stopwatch.stop();\n      return result;\n    } catch (e) {\n      success = false;\n      stopwatch.stop();\n      rethrow;\n    } finally {\n      record(PerformanceMetric(\n        name: name,\n        category: category,\n        durationMs: stopwatch.elapsedMilliseconds,\n        success: success,\n        timestamp: DateTime.now(),\n      ));\n    }\n  }\n\n  AuditReport generateReport() {\n    if (_metrics.isEmpty) {\n      return AuditReport(\n        totalOperations: 0,\n        successRate: 0,\n        avgDurationMs: 0,\n        p95DurationMs: 0,\n        p99DurationMs: 0,\n        slowestOperations: [],\n        categoryBreakdown: {},\n        recommendations: [],\n      );\n    }\n\n    final sorted = List<PerformanceMetric>.from(_metrics)\n      ..sort((a, b) => a.durationMs.compareTo(b.durationMs));\n\n    final successCount = _metrics.where((m) => m.success).length;\n    final successRate = successCount / _metrics.length * 100;\n\n    final avgDuration = _metrics\n            .map((m) => m.durationMs)\n            .reduce((a, b) => a + b) /\n        _metrics.length;\n\n    final p95Index = (sorted.length * 0.95).round().clamp(0, sorted.length - 1);\n    final p99Index = (sorted.length * 0.99).round().clamp(0, sorted.length - 1);\n\n    // Category breakdown\n    final categories = <String, List<PerformanceMetric>>{};\n    for (final metric in _metrics) {\n      categories.putIfAbsent(metric.category, () => []);\n      categories[metric.category]!.add(metric);\n    }\n\n    final breakdown = categories.map((cat, metrics) {\n      final avg = metrics.map((m) => m.durationMs).reduce((a, b) => a + b) /\n          metrics.length;\n      return MapEntry(cat, {\n        'count': metrics.length,\n        'avgMs': avg.round(),\n        'successRate': (metrics.where((m) => m.success).length / metrics.length * 100).round(),\n      });\n    });\n\n    // Slowest operations\n    final slowest = sorted.reversed.take(10).map((m) => m.toJson()).toList();\n\n    // Recommendations\n    final recommendations = _generateRecommendations(\n      successRate: successRate,\n      avgDuration: avgDuration,\n      p95Duration: sorted[p95Index].durationMs.toDouble(),\n      categories: categories,\n    );\n\n    return AuditReport(\n      totalOperations: _metrics.length,\n      successRate: successRate,\n      avgDurationMs: avgDuration,\n      p95DurationMs: sorted[p95Index].durationMs.toDouble(),\n      p99DurationMs: sorted[p99Index].durationMs.toDouble(),\n      slowestOperations: slowest,\n      categoryBreakdown: breakdown,\n      recommendations: recommendations,\n    );\n  }\n\n  List<String> _generateRecommendations({\n    required double successRate,\n    required double avgDuration,\n    required double p95Duration,\n    required Map<String, List<PerformanceMetric>> categories,\n  }) {\n    final recs = <String>[];\n\n    if (successRate < 95) {\n      recs.add('⚠️ Success rate is ${successRate.toStringAsFixed(1)}% — investigate failing operations');\n    }\n\n    if (avgDuration > 1000) {\n      recs.add('🐌 Average duration is ${avgDuration.round()}ms — consider caching or optimization');\n    }\n\n    if (p95Duration > 3000) {\n      recs.add('🔴 P95 duration is ${p95Duration.round()}ms — some operations are very slow');\n    }\n\n    for (final entry in categories.entries) {\n      final avg = entry.value.map((m) => m.durationMs).reduce((a, b) => a + b) /\n          entry.value.length;\n      if (avg > 2000) {\n        recs.add('📌 ${entry.key} category has high avg duration (${avg.round()}ms)');\n      }\n    }\n\n    if (recs.isEmpty) {\n      recs.add('✅ Performance looks good!');\n    }\n\n    return recs;\n  }\n\n  void clear() => _metrics.clear();\n\n  List<PerformanceMetric> get metrics => List.unmodifiable(_metrics);\n}\n\nclass AuditReport {\n  final int totalOperations;\n  final double successRate;\n  final double avgDurationMs;\n  final double p95DurationMs;\n  final double p99DurationMs;\n  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> slowestOperations;\n  final Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> categoryBreakdown;\n  final List<String> recommendations;\n\n  const AuditReport({\n    required this.totalOperations,\n    required this.successRate,\n    required this.avgDurationMs,\n    required this.p95DurationMs,\n    required this.p99DurationMs,\n    required this.slowestOperations,\n    required this.categoryBreakdown,\n    required this.recommendations,\n  });\n\n  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {\n        'totalOperations': totalOperations,\n        'successRate': successRate,\n        'avgDurationMs': avgDurationMs,\n        'p95DurationMs': p95DurationMs,\n        'p99DurationMs': p99DurationMs,\n        'slowestOperations': slowestOperations,\n        'categoryBreakdown': categoryBreakdown,\n        'recommendations': recommendations,\n        'generatedAt': DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),\n      };\n\n  @override\n  String toString() {\n    final buf = StringBuffer();\n    buf.writeln('═══ Performance Audit Report ═══');\n    buf.writeln('Total operations : $totalOperations');\n    buf.writeln('Success rate     : ${successRate.toStringAsFixed(1)}%');\n    buf.writeln('Avg duration     : ${avgDurationMs.round()}ms');\n    buf.writeln('P95 duration     : ${p95DurationMs.round()}ms');\n    buf.writeln('P99 duration     : ${p99DurationMs.round()}ms');\n    buf.writeln('');\n    buf.writeln('Recommendations:');\n    for (final rec in recommendations) {\n      buf.writeln('  $rec');\n    }\n    return buf.toString();\n  }\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n# بخش ۴: Security Audit\n\n## 📄 `lib/packages/core/lib/src/security/security_audit.dart`\n\n```dart\nimport 'dart:io';\n\nimport 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';\nimport 'package:sweetmelon/packages/core/lib/core.dart';\n\nclass SecurityAuditResult {\n  final String check;\n  final SecurityRisk risk;\n  final String message;\n  final String? recommendation;\n\n  const SecurityAuditResult({\n    required this.check,\n    required this.risk,\n    required this.message,\n    this.recommendation,\n  });\n\n  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {\n        'check': check,\n        'risk': risk.name,\n        'message': message,\n        if (recommendation != null) 'recommendation': recommendation,\n      };\n}\n\nenum SecurityRisk { pass, low, medium, high, critical }\n\nclass SecurityAuditor {\n  Future<SecurityAuditReport> audit() async {\n    BridgeLogger.info('SecurityAudit', 'Starting security audit...');\n\n    final results = <SecurityAuditResult>[];\n\n    // 1. Debug Mode\n    results.add(_checkDebugMode());\n\n    // 2. Root/Jailbreak\n    results.add(await _checkRootStatus());\n\n    // 3. AndroidManifest checks\n    results.add(await _checkManifest());\n\n    // 4. Cleartext Traffic\n    results.add(await _checkCleartextTraffic());\n\n    // 5. Certificate Pinning\n    results.add(_checkCertificatePinning());\n\n    // 6. Secure Storage\n    results.add(_checkSecureStorage());\n\n    // 7. Permission declarations\n    results.add(await _checkPermissions());\n\n    // 8. ProGuard\n    results.add(await _checkProguard());\n\n    // 9. Backup flag\n    results.add(await _checkBackup());\n\n    // 10. Network security config\n    results.add(await _checkNetworkSecurityConfig());\n\n    final report = SecurityAuditReport(results: results);\n\n    BridgeLogger.info(\n      'SecurityAudit',\n      'Audit complete: ${report.passCount} pass, '\n          '${report.issueCount} issues',\n    );\n\n    return report;\n  }\n\n  SecurityAuditResult _checkDebugMode() {\n    if (kDebugMode) {\n      return const SecurityAuditResult(\n        check: 'Debug Mode',\n        risk: SecurityRisk.high,\n        message: 'App is running in debug mode',\n        recommendation: 'Always build with --release for production',\n      );\n    }\n    return const SecurityAuditResult(\n      check: 'Debug Mode',\n      risk: SecurityRisk.pass,\n      message: 'Release mode enabled',\n    );\n  }\n\n  Future<SecurityAuditResult> _checkRootStatus() async {\n    if (!Platform.isAndroid) {\n      return const SecurityAuditResult(\n        check: 'Root Detection',\n        risk: SecurityRisk.pass,\n        message: 'Root detection is platform-specific (Android only)',\n      );\n    }\n\n    final suPaths = ['/system/bin/su', '/system/xbin/su', '/sbin/su'];\n    for (final path in suPaths) {\n      if (File(path).existsSync()) {\n        return const SecurityAuditResult(\n          check: 'Root Detection',\n          risk: SecurityRisk.high,\n          message: 'Device appears to be rooted',\n          recommendation: 'Consider restricting app functionality on rooted devices',\n        );\n      }\n    }\n\n    return const SecurityAuditResult(\n      check: 'Root Detection',\n      risk: SecurityRisk.pass,\n      message: 'No root indicators found',\n    );\n  }\n\n  Future<SecurityAuditResult> _checkManifest() async {\n    final manifest = File(\n      'android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml',\n    );\n\n    if (!await manifest.exists()) {\n      return const SecurityAuditResult(\n        check: 'AndroidManifest',\n        risk: SecurityRisk.medium,\n        message: 'AndroidManifest.xml not found for audit',\n      );\n    }\n\n    final content = await manifest.readAsString();\n\n    if (content.contains('android:debuggable=\"true\"')) {\n      return const SecurityAuditResult(\n        check: 'AndroidManifest',\n        risk: SecurityRisk.critical,\n        message: 'android:debuggable=\"true\" found in manifest',\n        recommendation: 'Remove debuggable=true from manifest',\n      );\n    }\n\n    return const SecurityAuditResult(\n      check: 'AndroidManifest',\n      risk: SecurityRisk.pass,\n      message: 'No debuggable flag in manifest',\n    );\n  }\n\n  Future<SecurityAuditResult> _checkCleartextTraffic() async {\n    final manifest = File(\n      'android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml',\n    );\n\n    if (!await manifest.exists()) {\n      return const SecurityAuditResult(\n        check: 'Cleartext Traffic',\n        risk: SecurityRisk.medium,\n        message: 'Cannot verify cleartext traffic setting',\n      );\n    }\n\n    final content = await manifest.readAsString();\n\n    if (content.contains('android:usesCleartextTraffic=\"true\"') &&\n        kReleaseMode) {\n      return const SecurityAuditResult(\n        check: 'Cleartext Traffic',\n        risk: SecurityRisk.medium,\n        message: 'Cleartext traffic allowed in release mode',\n        recommendation: 'Disable usesCleartextTraffic in production or restrict to localhost only',\n      );\n    }\n\n    return const SecurityAuditResult(\n      check: 'Cleartext Traffic',\n      risk: SecurityRisk.pass,\n      message: 'Cleartext traffic properly configured',\n    );\n  }\n\n  SecurityAuditResult _checkCertificatePinning() {\n    // این check باید runtime بشه\n    // در production باید SSL pinning فعال باشه\n    if (kReleaseMode) {\n      return const SecurityAuditResult(\n        check: 'Certificate Pinning',\n        risk: SecurityRisk.medium,\n        message: 'Verify SSL pinning is enabled for API endpoints',\n        recommendation: 'Enable SSL pinning in SecurityManager.production()',\n      );\n    }\n\n    return const SecurityAuditResult(\n      check: 'Certificate Pinning',\n      risk: SecurityRisk.low,\n      message: 'SSL pinning check skipped in debug mode',\n    );\n  }\n\n  SecurityAuditResult _checkSecureStorage() {\n    return const SecurityAuditResult(\n      check: 'Secure Storage',\n      risk: SecurityRisk.pass,\n      message: 'Secure storage plugin available (flutter_secure_storage)',\n    );\n  }\n\n  Future<SecurityAuditResult> _checkPermissions() async {\n    final manifest = File(\n      'android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml',\n    );\n\n    if (!await manifest.exists()) {\n      return const SecurityAuditResult(\n        check: 'Permissions',\n        risk: SecurityRisk.medium,\n        message: 'Cannot verify permissions',\n      );\n    }\n\n    final content = await manifest.readAsString();\n    final dangerousPerms = [\n      'READ_CONTACTS',\n      'READ_CALL_LOG',\n      'RECORD_AUDIO',\n      'READ_SMS',\n      'ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION',\n    ];\n\n    final found = dangerousPerms\n        .where((p) => content.contains('android.permission.$p'))\n        .toList();\n\n    if (found.length > 3) {\n      return SecurityAuditResult(\n        check: 'Permissions',\n        risk: SecurityRisk.medium,\n        message: 'Multiple sensitive permissions declared: ${found.join(\", \")}',\n        recommendation: 'Only declare permissions you actually use',\n      );\n    }\n\n    return const SecurityAuditResult(\n      check: 'Permissions',\n      risk: SecurityRisk.pass,\n      message: 'Permission declarations look reasonable',\n    );\n  }\n\n  Future<SecurityAuditResult> _checkProguard() async {\n    final proguard = File('android/app/proguard-rules.pro');\n\n    if (!await proguard.exists()) {\n      return const SecurityAuditResult(\n        check: 'ProGuard',\n        risk: SecurityRisk.high,\n        message: 'proguard-rules.pro not found',\n        recommendation: 'Add ProGuard rules for release builds',\n      );\n    }\n\n    final buildGradle = File('android/app/build.gradle');\n    if (await buildGradle.exists()) {\n      final content = await buildGradle.readAsString();\n      if (!content.contains('minifyEnabled true')) {\n        return const SecurityAuditResult(\n          check: 'ProGuard',\n          risk: SecurityRisk.medium,\n          message: 'minifyEnabled not set to true in build.gradle',\n          recommendation: 'Enable minification for release builds',\n        );\n      }\n    }\n\n    return const SecurityAuditResult(\n      check: 'ProGuard',\n      risk: SecurityRisk.pass,\n      message: 'ProGuard configuration found',\n    );\n  }\n\n  Future<SecurityAuditResult> _checkBackup() async {\n    final manifest = File(\n      'android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml',\n    );\n\n    if (!await manifest.exists()) {\n      return const SecurityAuditResult(\n        check: 'Backup Configuration',\n        risk: SecurityRisk.low,\n        message: 'Cannot verify backup configuration',\n      );\n    }\n\n    final content = await manifest.readAsString();\n\n    if (content.contains('android:allowBackup=\"true\"') &&\n        !content.contains('android:fullBackupContent') &&\n        !content.contains('android:dataExtractionRules')) {\n      return const SecurityAuditResult(\n        check: 'Backup Configuration',\n        risk: SecurityRisk.medium,\n        message: 'allowBackup=true without backup rules',\n        recommendation: 'Add fullBackupContent or dataExtractionRules to control what gets backed up',\n      );\n    }\n\n    return const SecurityAuditResult(\n      check: 'Backup Configuration',\n      risk: SecurityRisk.pass,\n      message: 'Backup configuration is set',\n    );\n  }\n\n  Future<SecurityAuditResult> _checkNetworkSecurityConfig() async {\n    final config = File(\n      'android/app/src/main/res/xml/network_security_config.xml',\n    );\n\n    if (!await config.exists()) {\n      return const SecurityAuditResult(\n        check: 'Network Security Config',\n        risk: SecurityRisk.medium,\n        message: 'network_security_config.xml not found',\n        recommendation: 'Add network security config to restrict HTTP traffic',\n      );\n    }\n\n    final content = await config.readAsString();\n\n    if (kReleaseMode &&\n        content.contains('cleartextTrafficPermitted=\"true\"') &&\n        !content.contains('localhost')) {\n      return const SecurityAuditResult(\n        check: 'Network Security Config',\n        risk: SecurityRisk.high,\n        message: 'Cleartext traffic permitted globally in release',\n        recommendation: 'Restrict cleartext to localhost only in production',\n      );\n    }\n\n    return const SecurityAuditResult(\n      check: 'Network Security Config',\n      risk: SecurityRisk.pass,\n      message: 'Network security config present',\n    );\n  }\n}\n\nclass SecurityAuditReport {\n  final List<SecurityAuditResult> results;\n  final DateTime auditedAt;\n\n  SecurityAuditReport({\n    required this.results,\n  }) : auditedAt = DateTime.now();\n\n  int get passCount => results.where((r) => r.risk == SecurityRisk.pass).length;\n  int get issueCount => results.where((r) => r.risk != SecurityRisk.pass).length;\n  int get criticalCount =>\n      results.where((r) => r.risk == SecurityRisk.critical).length;\n  int get highCount =>\n      results.where((r) => r.risk == SecurityRisk.high).length;\n  int get mediumCount =>\n      results.where((r) => r.risk == SecurityRisk.medium).length;\n\n  SecurityRisk get overallRisk {\n    if (criticalCount > 0) return SecurityRisk.critical;\n    if (highCount > 0) return SecurityRisk.high;\n    if (mediumCount > 0) return SecurityRisk.medium;\n    if (results.any((r) => r.risk == SecurityRisk.low)) return SecurityRisk.low;\n    return SecurityRisk.pass;\n  }\n\n  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {\n        'auditedAt': auditedAt.toIso8601String(),\n        'overallRisk': overallRisk.name,\n        'summary': {\n          'pass': passCount,\n          'critical': criticalCount,\n          'high': highCount,\n          'medium': mediumCount,\n          'total': results.length,\n        },\n        'results': results.map((r) => r.toJson()).toList(),\n      };\n\n  @override\n  String toString() {\n    final buf = StringBuffer();\n    buf.writeln('═══ Security Audit Report ═══');\n    buf.writeln('Overall Risk : ${overallRisk.name.toUpperCase()}');\n    buf.writeln('Pass         : $passCount/${results.length}');\n    buf.writeln('Critical     : $criticalCount');\n    buf.writeln('High         : $highCount');\n    buf.writeln('Medium       : $mediumCount');\n    buf.writeln('');\n\n    final issues = results.where((r) => r.risk != SecurityRisk.pass).toList();\n    if (issues.isNotEmpty) {\n      buf.writeln('Issues:');\n      for (final issue in issues) {\n        buf.writeln('  [${issue.risk.name.toUpperCase()}] ${issue.check}: ${issue.message}');\n        if (issue.recommendation != null) {\n          buf.writeln('    → ${issue.recommendation}');\n        }\n      }\n    } else {\n      buf.writeln('✅ No security issues found!');\n    }\n\n    return buf.toString();\n  }\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n# بخش ۵: Release Checklist\n\n## 📄 ((receivedBytes / totalBytes) * 100).round()\n            : -1;\n\n        _emitEvent('update.downloadProgress', {\n          'version': bundle.version,\n          'receivedBytes': receivedBytes,\n          'totalBytes': totalBytes,\n          'percent': percent,\n        });\n      }\n\n      await sink.flush();\n      await sink.close();\n      client.close();\n\n      // Verify checksum\n      _setStatus(BundleStatus.error, error: 'Checksum mismatch');\n          await bundleDir.delete(recursive: true);\n\n          return {\n            'downloaded': false,\n            'reason': 'checksum_mismatch',\n            'expected': bundle.checksum,\n            'actual': hash,\n          };\n        }\n\n        BridgeLogger.info('LiveUpdater', 'Checksum verified');\n      }\n\n      final indexFile = File(p.join(extractDir, 'index.html'));\n      if (!await indexFile.exists()) {\n        _setStatus(BundleStatus.error, error: 'Missing index.html');\n        await bundleDir.delete(recursive: true);\n        return {\n          'downloaded': false,\n          'reason': 'invalid_bundle',\n          'message': 'Bundle must contain index.html',\n        };\n      }\n\n      _setStatus(BundleStatus.ready);\n\n      _emitEvent('update.downloaded', {\n        'version': bundle.version,\n        'size': receivedBytes,\n        'path': extractDir,\n      });\n\n      return {\n        'downloaded': true,\n        'version': bundle.version,\n        'size': receivedBytes,\n        'path': extractDir,\n      };\n    } catch (e) {\n      _setStatus(BundleStatus.error, error: e.toString());\n      return {'downloaded': false, 'error': e.toString()};\n    }\n  }\n\n  // ── Apply Update ──\n\n  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> _applyUpdate() async {\n    if (_status != BundleStatus.ready || _availableUpdate == null) {\n      return {'applied': false, 'reason': 'no_update_ready'};\n    }\n\n    _setStatus(BundleStatus.applying);\n\n    try {\n      final tempDir = await getTemporaryDirectory();\n      final bundleDir = Directory(\n        p.join(\n          tempDir.path,\n          'live_updates',\n          _availableUpdate!.version,\n          'www',\n        ),\n      );\n\n      if (!await bundleDir.exists()) {\n        _setStatus(BundleStatus.error, error: 'Bundle directory not found');\n        return {'applied': false, _prefs?.getString(_prefKeyAppliedBundle) ?? backupDir.delete(recursive: true);\n        }\n        await activeWww.rename(backupDir.path);\n      }\n\n      // Copy new bundle to active\n      await _copyDirectory(bundleDir, activeWww);\n\n $previousVersion → $_currentVersion',\n      );\n\n      _emitEvent('update.applied', {\n        'previousVersion': previousVersion,\n        'newVersion': _currentVersion,\n        'requiresReload': true,\n      });\n\n      return {\n        'applied': true,\n        'previousVersion': previousVersion,\n        'newVersion': _currentVersion,\n        'requiresReload': true,\n        'message': Auto rollback on error\n      await _rollback();\n\n      return {'applied': false, 'error': e.toString()};\n    }\n  }\n\n  // ── Check and Apply (one-step) ──\n\n  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> _checkAndApply(\n    Map<String, dynamic> args,\n  ) async {\n    final silent = args['silent'] as bool? ?? false;\n\n    // Check\n    final checkResult = await _checkForUpdate();\n    if (checkResult['available'] != true) {\n      return {\n        'updated': false,\n        'reason': 'no_update',\n        'currentVersion': _currentVersion,\n      };\n    }\n\n    // Download\n 'newVersion': applyResult['newVersion'],\n      'requiresReload': true,\n    };\n  }\n\n  // ── Rollback ──\n\n  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> _rollback() async {\n    _setStatus(BundleStatus.rollingBack);\n\n    try {\n      final appDir = await getApplicationDocumentsDirectory();\n      final activeWww = Directory(p.join(appDir.path, 'active_www'));\n      final backupDir = Directory(p.join(appDir.path, 'backup_www'));\n\n      if (!await backupDir.exists()) {\n        _setStatus(BundleStatus.idle);\n        return {'rolledBack': false, 'reason': 'no_backup'};\n      }\n\n      // Restore backup\n      if (await activeWww.exists()) {\n        await activeWww.delete(recursive: true);\n      }\n      await backupDir.rename(activeWww.path);\n\n '';\n      if (previousJson.isNotEmpty) {\n        try {\n          final previousBundle = BundleInfo.fromJson(\n            jsonDecode(previousJson) as Map<String, dynamic>,\n          );\n          _currentVersion = previousBundle.version;\n          _appliedBundle = previousBundle;\n        } catch (_) {\n          _currentVersion = '0.0.0';\n          _appliedBundle = null;\n        }\n      } else {\n        _currentVersion = '0.0.0';\n        _appliedBundle = null;\n      }\n\n      await _prefs?.setString(_prefKeyCurrentVersion, _currentVersion);\n\n      _setStatus(BundleStatus.idle);\n\n      BridgeLogger.info(\n        'LiveUpdater',\n        'Rolled back to version: $_currentVersion',\n      );\n\n      _emitEvent('update.rolledBack', {\n        'version': _currentVersion,\n        'requiresReload': true,\n      });\n\n      return {\n        'rolledBack': true,\n        'version': _currentVersion,\n        'requiresReload': true,\n      };\n    } catch (e) {\n      _setStatus(BundleStatus.error, error: e.toString());\n      return {'rolledBack': false, 'error': e.toString()};\n    }\n  }\n\n  // ── Auto Rollback ──\n\n  Future<void> _checkAutoRollback() async {\n    final failCount = _prefs?.getInt(_prefKeyFailCount) ?? device motion and orientation sensors.\n\n## Plugin Name\n`sensors`\n\n## Methods\n\n| Method | Sensor | Description |\n|--------|--------|-------------|\n| `startAccelerometer` | Accelerometer | gravity + motion (m/s²) |\n| `stopAccelerometer` | — | — |\n| `startGyroscope` | Gyroscope | rotation rate (rad/s) |\n| `stopGyroscope` | — | — |\n| `startMagnetometer` | Magnetometer | magnetic field (μT) |\n| `stopMagnetometer` | — | — |\n| `startUserAccelerometer` | User Accel | motion without gravity |\n| `stopUserAccelerometer` | — | — |\n| `stopAll` | — | stop all sensors |\n| `getActiveStreams` | — | list active sensors |\n\n**Options for all start methods:**\n| Param | Type | Default |\n|-------|------|---------|\n| `intervalMs` | `number` | `100` |\n\n## Events\n| Event | Data |\n|-------|------|\n| `sensors.accelerometer` | `{ x, y, z, timestamp }` |\n| `sensors.gyroscope` | `{ x, y, z, timestamp }` |\n| `sensors.magnetometer` | `{ x, y, z, timestamp }` |\n| `sensors.userAccelerometer` | `{ x, y, z, timestamp }` |\n\n## Usage\n```javascript\n// Shake detection (manual)\nlet lastX = 0, lastY = 0, lastZ = 0;\nawait NativeSDK.sensors.startAccelerometer({ intervalMs: 50 });\nNativeSDK.on('sensors.accelerometer', (data) => {\n  const delta = Math.abs(data.x - lastX) + Math.abs(data.y - lastY);\n  if (delta > 15) console.log('Shake!');\n  lastX = data.x; lastY = data.y; lastZ = data.z;\n});\n\n// Compass heading\nawait NativeSDK.sensors.startMagnetometer({ intervalMs: 200 });\nNativeSDK.on('sensors.magnetometer', (data) => {\n  const heading = Plugin\n\nReceive shared content from other apps.\n\n## Plugin Name\n`shareTarget`\n\n## Methods\n\n| Method | Returns |\n|--------|---------|\n| `startListening` | `{ listening: true }` |\n| `stopListening` | `{ listening: false }` |\n| `getLastShared` | shared data or `{ available: false }` |\n| `clearLastShared` | `{ cleared: true }` |\n\n**Shared Data Format:**\n```json\n{\n  \"type\": \"text\",\n  \"text\": \"Check out this link!\",\n  \"title\": \"From Chrome\"\n}\n```\nor\n```json\n{\n  \"type\": \"files\",\n  \"paths\": [\"/path/to/file.jpg\"],\n  \"mimeType\": \"image/jpeg\"\n}\n```\n\n## Events\n| Event | Data |\n|-------|------|\n| `shareTarget.received` | shared data object |\n\n## Setup (Android)\nAdd to `AndroidManifest.xml`:\n```xml\n<intent-filter>\n  <action android:name=\"android.intent.action.SEND\"/>\n  <category android:name=\"android.intent.category.DEFAULT\"/>\n  <data android:mimeType=\"text/plain\"/>\n</intent-filter>\n<intent-filter>\n  <action android:name=\"android.intent.action.SEND\"/>\n  <category android:name=\"android.intent.category.DEFAULT\"/>\n  <data android:mimeType=\"image/*\"/>\n</intent-filter>\n```\n\n## Usage\n```javascript\nawait NativeSDK.shareTarget.startListening();\n\nNativeSDK.on('shareTarget.received', async (data) => {\n  if (data.type === 'text') {\n    // User shared text/URL from another app\n    document.getElementById('input').value = data.text;\n    await NativeSDK.toast.show('Content received!');\n  } else if (data.type === 'files') {\n    // User shared image/file\n    uploadFiles(data.paths);\n  }\n});\n\n// Check on app start\nconst lastShared = await NativeSDK.shareTarget.getLastShared();\nif (lastShared.available !== false) {\n  handleSharedContent(lastShared);\n  await NativeSDK.shareTarget.clearLastShared();\n}\n```\n```\n\n---\n\n# README‌های فاز ۱۰\n\n## 📄 `lib/plugins/in_app_review/README.md`\n\n```markdown\n# In-App Review Plugin\n\nPrompt users for app store ratings without leaving the app.\n\n## Plugin Name\n`inAppReview`\n\n## Methods\n\n| Method | Returns |\n|--------|---------|\n| `isAvailable` | `{ available: bool }` |\n| `requestReview` | `{ requested: bool }` |\n| `openStoreListing` | `{ opened: bool }` |\n\n## Important Notes\n- Google limits how often the review dialog can be shown\n- Don't call after a button press — trigger naturally after positive actions\n- No guarantee the dialog will appear every time\n\n## Usage\n```javascript\n// After completing a key action\nasync function onOrderCompleted() {\n  const { available } = await NativeSDK.inAppReview.isAvailable();\n  if (!available) return;\n\n  // Check if enough time has passed (track in storage)\n  const lastReview = await NativeSDK.storage.get('last_review_request');\n  const daysSince = lastReview \n    ? (Date.now() - lastReview) / 86400000 \n    : Infinity;\n\n  if (daysSince > 30) {  // once per 30 days max\n    await NativeSDK.inAppReview.requestReview();\n    await NativeSDK.storage.set('last_review_request', Date.now());\n  }\n}\n\n// Explicit store link (settings page)\nawait NativeSDK.inAppReview.openStoreListing();\n```\n```\n\n---\n\n## 📄 Plugin\n\nDeploy updates to www assets without Play Store review.\n\n## Plugin Name\n`liveUpdater`\n\n## Methods\n\n### `configure`\n| Param | Type | Required | Default |\n|-------|------|----------|---------|\n| `serverUrl` | `string` | ✅ | — |\n| `apiKey` | `string` | — | — |\n| `channel` | `string` | — | `\"production\"` |\n| `currentVersion` | `string` | — | — |\n\n### `checkForUpdate`\n**Returns:**\n```json\n{ \"available\": true, \"currentVersion\": \"1.0.0\", \"newVersion\": \"1.1.0\", \"size\": 524288 }\n```\n\n### `downloadUpdate`\nDownloads bundle with progress events.\n\n### `applyUpdate`\nApply downloaded bundle. Requires reload.\n\n**Returns:**\n```json\n{ \"applied\": true, \"previousVersion\": \"1.0.0\", \"newVersion\": \"1.1.0\", \"requiresReload\": true }\n```\n\n### `checkAndApply`\nOne-step: check + download + apply.\n| Param | Type | Default |\n|-------|------|---------|\n| `silent` | `bool` | `false` |\n\n### `rollback`\nRevert to previous version.\n\n### `getCurrentVersion` / `getAvailableUpdate` / `getStatus`\n### `getUpdateHistory` / `setChannel` / `reset`\n\n## Events\n| Event | Data |\n|-------|------|\n| `update.available` | `{ version, size, currentVersion }` |\n| `update.downloadProgress` | `{ percent, receivedBytes, totalBytes }` |\n| `update.downloaded` | `{ version, size }` |\n| `update.applied` | `{ previousVersion, newVersion, requiresReload }` |\n| `update.rolledBack` | `{ version, requiresReload }` |\n| `update.autoRolledBack` | `{ reason, failCount }` |\n\n## Server API Required\n\n```\nGET /api/updates/check\nHeaders:\n  X-Current-Version: 1.0.0\n  X-Channel: production\n  X-Platform: android\n\nResponse:\n{\n  \"updateAvailable\": true,\n  \"latestVersion\": \"1.1.0\",\n  \"bundle\": {\n    \"version\": \"1.1.0\",\n    \"url\": \"https://cdn.myapp.com/bundles/1.1.0.zip\",\n    \"checksum\": \"sha256...\",\n    \"size\": 524288\n  }\n}\n```\n\n## Bundle Format\nZIP file containing:\n```\n1.1.0.zip\n├── index.html    ← required\n├── css/\n├── js/\n└── assets/\n```\n\n## Usage\n\n### Basic (manual update)\n```javascript\nawait NativeSDK.liveUpdater.configure({\n  serverUrl: 'https://updates.myapp.com',\n  channel: 'production'\n});\n\nconst check = await NativeSDK.liveUpdater.checkForUpdate();\nif (check.available) {\n  \n  NativeSDK.on('update.downloadProgress', (data) => {\n    progressBar.style.width = data.percent + '%';\n  });\n  \n  await NativeSDK.liveUpdater.downloadUpdate();\n  await NativeSDK.liveUpdater.applyUpdate();\n  location.reload();\n}\n```\n\n### Silent background update\n```javascript\n// Check on startup silently\nNativeSDK.waitForReady().then(async () => {\n  await NativeSDK.liveUpdater.configure({\n    serverUrl: 'https://updates.myapp.com'\n  });\n  \n  const result = await NativeSDK.liveUpdater.checkAndApply({ silent: true });\n  if (result.updated) {\n    await NativeSDK.toast.show('App updated to v' + result.newVersion);\n    setTimeout(() => location.reload(), 2000);\n  }\n});\n```\n\n### Channel management\n```javascript\n// Beta testers\nawait NativeSDK.liveUpdater.setChannel('beta');\n\n// Production\nawait NativeSDK.liveUpdater.setChannel('production');\n\n// Rollback if issues\nNativeSDK.on('update.autoRolledBack', async (data) => {\n  console.error('Auto-rollback:', data.reason);\n  await HTML/JS/CSS App            │\n│  (Angular, React, Vue, vanilla)     │\n├─────────────────────────────────────┤\n│         NativeSDK (JS)              │\n├─────────────────────────────────────┤\n│      Message Bridge (Dart)          │\n├─────────────────────────────────────┤\n│   Security │ Cache │ Rate Limit     │\n├─────────────────────────────────────┤\n│     91 Native Plugin Registry Introduction\n\n## What is Sweetmelon?\n\nSweetmelon is a **Flutter-based native bridge** that lets you run HTML/CSS/JS applications (Angular, React, Vue, or vanilla) inside a Flutter WebView while providing access to **91 native device APIs** through a simple JavaScript SDK.\n\nThink of it as an alternative to **Capacitor** or **Cordova**, but built on Flutter's powerful engine.\n\n## Why Sweetmelon?\n\n### vs Capacitor\n| Feature | Sweetmelon | Capacitor |\n|---------|-----------|-----------|\n| Runtime | Flutter | Native Android/iOS |\n| Plugins | 91 built-in | ~80 (community) |\n| Live Updates | ✅ Built-in | Via Capgo (paid) |\n| Security | ✅ 5 layers | Basic |\n| Offline Queue | ✅ Built-in | Manual |\n| Plugin Dev | Dart | Java/Kotlin + Swift |\n\n### vs React Native / Flutter\n| Feature | Sweetmelon | React Native | Pure Flutter |\n|---------|-----------|-------------|-------------|\n| UI Technology | HTML/CSS/JS | React | Dart/Widgets |\n| Learning Curve | Low (web devs) | Medium | High |\n| Web Reuse | ✅ 100% | ❌ | ❌ |\n| Native Access | 91 plugins | Many packages | Many packages |\n| Performance | Good | Very Good | Excellent |\n\n### When to use Sweetmelon\n\n✅ **Use when:**\n- You have an existing web app (Angular/React/Vue)\n- Your team knows web technologies\n- You need quick native features\n- You want live updates without store review\n- You need offline-first with sync\n\n❌ **Don't use when:**\n- You need maximum performance (games, heavy animations)\n- You're building from scratch (consider pure Flutter)\n- You need advanced native UI components\n\n## Core Concepts\n\n### 1. Bridge\nThe communication layer between JavaScript and Dart/Native code.\n\n### 2. Plugins\nSelf-contained modules that expose native APIs to JavaScript.\n\n### 3. NativeSDK\nThe JavaScript wrapper that provides a clean API for all plugins.\n\n### 4. Asset Server\nA local HTTP server that serves your HTML/CSS/JS files to the WebView.\n\n### 5. Security Manager\nAuthentication, signing, and protection for the bridge communication.\n\n## Architecture\n\n```\nYour Web App (Angular/React/Vue)\n        ↓\n   NativeSDK.call()\n        ↓\n   Message Bridge (JSON protocol)\n        ↓\n   Security Layer (auth + signing)\n        ↓\n   Plugin Manager (cache + rate limit)\n        ↓\n   Plugin Registry (91 plugins)\n        ↓\n   Native APIs (Android/iOS)\n```\n```\n\n---\n\n## 📄 `docs/guide/getting-started.md`\n\n```markdown\n# Getting Started\n\n## Prerequisites\n\n- Flutter SDK 3.0+\n- Android Studio / VS Code\n- Node.js 18+ (for web app build)\n- Android device or emulator (API 21+)\n\n## Step 1: Create Project\n\n```bash\n# Option A: Use CLI\ndart run bin/sweetmelon.dart create project my_app\ncd my_app\n\n# Option B: Manual\nflutter create --org com.example my_app\ncd my_app\n# Copy Sweetmelon files...\n```\n\n## Step 2: Configure Plugins\n\nEdit `sweetmelon.yaml`:\n\n```yaml\nplugins:\n  permission:\n    enabled: true\n  storage:\n    enabled: true\n  http:\n    enabled: true\n  # ... enable what you need\n```\n\nApply configuration:\n\n```bash\ndart run bin/sweetmelon.dart configure\n```\n\n## Step 3: Add Your Web App\n\nPlace your built web app in `assets/www/`:\n\n```bash\n# Angular\nng build --configuration production \\\n  --output-path assets/www \\\n  --base-href ./\n\n# React\nGENERATE_SOURCEMAP=false npm run build\ncp -r build/* assets/www/\n\n# Vue\nnpm run build\ncp -r dist/* assets/www/\n\n# Vanilla HTML\n# Just put files in assets/www/\n```\n\n**Important:** Include `native-sdk.js` in your HTML:\n\n```html\n<script src=\"js/native-sdk.js\"></script>\n```\n\n## Step 4: Use NativeSDK\n\n```javascript\n// Wait for bridge to be ready\nawait NativeSDK.waitForReady();\n\n// Now use any plugin\nconst info = await NativeSDK.deviceInfo.getAll();\nconsole.log('Device:', info.device.model);\n\n// Store data\nawait NativeSDK.storage.set('user', { name: 'Ali' });\n\n// Listen to events\nNativeSDK.on('connectivity.change', (data) => {\n  console.log('Online:', data.online);\n});\n```\n\n## Step 5: Run\n\n```bash\nflutter run\n```\n\n## Next Steps\n\n- [Configuration →](/guide/configuration)\n- [Browse all 91 plugins →](/plugins/overview)\n- [Angular integration →](/guide/frameworks/angular)\n- [Security guide →](/advanced/security)\n```\n\n---\n\n## 📄 `docs/plugins/overview.md`\n\n```markdown\n# All Plugins\n\nSweetmelon includes **91 built-in plugins** organized in categories.\n\n## Core (10 plugins) Subscribe\nconst unsubscribe = NativeSDK.on('event.name', (data) => {\n  console.log(data);\n});\n\n// Unsubscribe\nunsubscribe();\n```\n\n## All Events\n\n### App & System\n\n| Event | Plugin | Data | Description |\n|-------|--------|------|-------------|\n| `app.lifecycle.change` | appLifecycle | `{ state, previousState }` | App state changed |\n| `connectivity.change` | connectivity | `{ online, primary, types }` | Network changed |\n| `keyboard.change` | keyboard | `{ visible, height }` | Keyboard show/hide |\n| `backButton.pressed` | backButton | `{ intercepted }` | Back button pressed |\n\n### Location\n\n| Event | Plugin | Data | Description |\n|-------|--------|------|-------------|\n| `geolocation.position` | geolocation | Position object | Position update |\n| `geolocation.error` | geolocation | `{ message }` | Location error |\n| `bgGeo.position` | backgroundGeolocation | Position object | Background position |\n\n### Media\n\n| Event | Plugin | Data | Description |\n|-------|--------|------|-------------|\n| `audio.playerState` | audio | `{ state, isPlaying }` | Audio state |\n| `audio.position` | audio | `{ positionMs }` | Playback position |\n| `cameraPreview.photoTaken` | cameraPreview | `{ path, size }` | Photo captured |\n| `qrScanner.scanned` | qrScanner | `{ value, format }` | QR/barcode scanned |\n\n### Notifications\n\n| Event | Plugin | Data | Description |\n|-------|--------|------|-------------|\n| `notification.tap` | notification | `{ id, payload }` | Notification tapped |\n| `push.received` | pushNotification | `{ title, body, data }` | Push received |\n| `push.tap` | pushNotification | `{ title, body, data }` | Push tapped |\n| `push.tokenRefreshed` | pushNotification | `{ token }` | FCM token changed |\n\n### Hardware\n\n| Event | Plugin | Data | Description |\n|-------|--------|------|-------------|\n| `bluetooth.deviceFound` | bluetooth | `{ deviceId, name, rssi }` | BLE device found |\n| `nfc.tagDiscovered` | nfc | `{ id, type, records }` | NFC tag read |\n| `sensors.accelerometer` | sensors | `{ x, y, z }` | Accelerometer data |\n| `sensors.gyroscope` | sensors | `{ x, y, z }` | Gyroscope data |\n| `shake.detected` | shakeDetection | `{ magnitude, count }` | Device shaken |\n| `volume.pressed` | volumeButtons | `{ direction }` | Volume button |\n| `pedometer.step` | pedometer | `{ steps }` | Step counted |\n| `alarm.fired` | alarm | `{ alarmId, title }` | Alarm triggered |\n\n### Network\n\n| Event | Plugin | Data | Description |\n|-------|--------|------|-------------|\n| `websocket.message` | websocket | `{ id, data, type }` | WS message |\n| `websocket.connected` | websocket | `{ id, url }` | WS connected |\n| `websocket.disconnected` | websocket | `{ id, closeCode }` | WS disconnected |\n| `download.progress` | downloadManager | `{ taskId, percent }` | Download progress |\n| `download.complete` | downloadManager | `{ taskId, path }` | Download done |\n\n### Auth & Purchase\n\n| Event | Plugin | Data | Description |\n|-------|--------|------|-------------|\n| `auth.stateChanged` | firebaseAuth | `{ user, signedIn }` | Auth state |\n| `socialLogin.signedIn` | socialLogin | `{ provider, user }` | Social login |\n| `purchase.completed` | inAppPurchase | `{ productId }` | Purchase done |\n| `purchase.error` | inAppPurchase | `{ errorMessage }` | Purchase failed |\n\n### Updates\n\n| Event | Plugin | Data | Description |\n|-------|--------|------|-------------|\n| `update.available` | liveUpdater | `{ version, size }` | Update found |\n| `update.downloadProgress` | liveUpdater | `{ percent }` | Downloading |\n| `update.applied` | liveUpdater | `{ newVersion }` | Update applied |\n| `update.rolledBack` | liveUpdater | `{ version }` | Rolled back |\n\n### Tasks\n\n| Event | Plugin | Data | Description |\n|-------|--------|------|-------------|\n| `task.started` | backgroundTask | `{ taskId }` | Task started |\n| `task.completed` | backgroundTask | `{ taskId, result }` | Task done |\n| `task.failed` | backgroundTask | `{ taskId, error }` | Task failed |\n```\n\n---\n\n## مرحله ۲: dart doc\n\n```bash\n# تولید Server Plugin\n\nReceive UDP datagrams and respond or broadcast.\n\n## Plugin Name\n`udpServer`\n\n## Methods\n\n| Method | Args | Description |\n|--------|------|-------------|\n| `start` | `port?, host?, broadcast?, id?` | Bind UDP server |\n| `stop` | `id` | Stop specific server |\n| `stopAll` | — | Stop all servers |\n| `sendTo` | `serverId, data, host, port` | Send to specific address |\n| `broadcast` | `serverId, data, port, broadcastAddress?` | Broadcast to network |\n| `getServers` | — | List active servers |\n| `getStats` | `id` | Server statistics |\n\n## Events\n\n| Event | Data |\n|-------|------|\n| `udpServer.started` | `{ id, port, host }` |\n| `udpServer.data` | `{ serverId, data, senderAddress, senderPort, bytes }` |\n\n## Usage\n\n```javascript\n// Start UDP server\nconst { id, port } = await NativeSDK.udpServer.start({ port: 5000 });\nconsole.log('UDP listening on port:', port);\n\n// Receive data\nNativeSDK.on('udpServer.data', (msg) => {\n  console.log(`From ${msg.senderAddress}:${msg.senderPort} → ${msg.data}`);\n  \n  // Echo back\n  NativeSDK.udpServer.sendTo(msg.serverId, 'ACK: ' + msg.data, msg.senderAddress, msg.senderPort);\n});\n\n// Broadcast discovery\nawait NativeSDK.udpServer.broadcast(id, 'DISCOVER', 5001);\n\n// Device discovery pattern\nconst discoveryServer = await NativeSDK.udpServer.start({ port: 5001, broadcast: true });\n\nNativeSDK.on('udpServer.data', (msg) => {\n  if (msg.data === 'DISCOVER') {\n    const myInfo = JSON.stringify({ name: 'MyDevice', ip: myIp });\n    NativeSDK.udpServer.sendTo(discoveryServer.id, myInfo, msg.senderAddress, msg.senderPort);\n  }\n});\n\n// Stats\nconst stats = await NativeSDK.udpServer.getStats(id);\nconsole.log('Received:', stats.receivedCount, 'packets');\n\n// Cleanup\nawait NativeSDK.udpServer.stopAll();\n```\n```\n\n---\n\n## 📄 `lib/plugins/tcp_server/README.md`\n\n```markdown\n# TCP Server Plugin\n\nMulti-client TCP server with message routing.\n\n## Plugin Name\n`tcpServer`\n\n## Methods\n\n| Method | Args | Description |\n|--------|------|-------------|\n| `start` | `port?, host?, maxClients?, id?` | Start TCP server |\n| `stop` | `id` | Stop server |\n| `stopAll` | — | Stop all servers |\n| `sendToClient` | `serverId, clientId, data` | Send to one client |\n| `sendToAll` | `serverId, data, exclude?` | Broadcast to all clients |\n| `disconnectClient` | `serverId, clientId` | Kick a client |\n| `getClients` | `serverId` | List connected clients |\n| `getServers` | — | List active servers |\n| `getStats` | `id` | Server statistics |\n\n## Events\n\n| Event | Data |\n|-------|------|\n| `tcpServer.started` | `{ id, port, host, maxClients }` |\n| `tcpServer.clientConnected` | `{ serverId, clientId, remoteAddress, remotePort }` |\n| `tcpServer.data` | `{ serverId, clientId, data, bytes, messageNumber }` |\n| `tcpServer.clientDisconnected` | `{ serverId, clientId, totalClients }` |\n| `tcpServer.clientError` | `{ serverId, clientId, error }` |\n\n## Usage\n\n```javascript\n// Chat server\nconst srv = await NativeSDK.tcpServer.start({ port: 9000, maxClients: 50 });\nconsole.log('TCP server on port:', srv.port);\n\n// Handle messages\nNativeSDK.on('tcpServer.data', (msg) => {\n  console.log(`[${msg.clientId}]: ${msg.data}`);\n  \n  // Broadcast to all except sender\n  NativeSDK.tcpServer.sendToAll(msg.serverId, `${msg.clientId}: ${msg.data}`, msg.clientId);\n});\n\n// Welcome new clients\nNativeSDK.on('tcpServer.clientConnected', (client) => {\n  NativeSDK.tcpServer.sendToClient(client.serverId, client.clientId, 'Welcome!\\n');\n  NativeSDK.tcpServer.sendToAll(client.serverId, `${client.clientId} joined\\n`, client.clientId);\n});\n\n// Handle disconnection\nNativeSDK.on('tcpServer.clientDisconnected', (client) => {\n  NativeSDK.tcpServer.sendToAll(client.serverId, `${client.clientId} left\\n`);\n});\n\n// Admin kick\nawait NativeSDK.tcpServer.disconnectClient(srv.id, 'client_5');\n\n// Stats\nconst stats = await NativeSDK.tcpServer.getStats(srv.id);\nconsole.log('Clients:', stats.clients, 'Total bytes:', stats.totalReceivedBytes);\n```\n```\n\n---\n\n## 📄 `lib/plugins/ftp_server/README.md`\n\n```markdown\n# FTP Server Plugin\n\nSimple FTP server for sharing files from device.\n\n## Plugin username }` |\n| `ftpServer.fileUploaded` | `{ sessionId, file }` |\n| `ftpServer.fileDownloaded` | `{ sessionId, file }` |\n\n## Supported FTP Commands\nUSER, PASS, PWD, CWD, LIST, RETR, STOR, DELE, MKD, RMD, SIZE, PASV, TYPE, SYST, FEAT, QUIT, NOOP\n\n## Usage\n\n```javascript\n// Start FTP server\nconst dirs = await NativeSDK.fileSystem.getDirectories();\nconst { port, url } = await info\nconst { ip } = await NativeSDK.networkInfo.getLocalIp();\nawait NativeSDK.dialog.alert({\n  title: 'FTP Server Running',\n  message: `Connect with any FTP client:\\n\\nHost: ${ip}\\nPort: ${port}\\nUser: user\\nPass: pass123`\n});\n\n// Monitor uploads\nNativeSDK.on('ftpServer.fileUploaded', (data) => {\n  NativeSDK.toast.show('File received: ' + data.file);\n});\n\n// Monitor Note\nThis is a simplified command server using plain TCP, NOT the real SSH protocol. password?` | Start server |\n| `stop` | — | Stop server |\n| `getClients` | — | Connected sessions |\n| `getStats` | — | Statistics |\n| `kickClient` | `sessionId` | Disconnect a session |\n| sessionId, remoteAddress }` |\n| `sshServer.clientDisconnected` | `{ sessionId }` |\n| `sshServer.login` | `{ sessionId, username }` |\n| `sshServer.command` | `{ sessionId, command, args, fullCommand }` |\n| `sshServer.commandOutput` | `{ sessionId, command, exitCode, outputLength }` |\n\n## Default Allowed Commands (Sandbox)\n`ls`, `pwd`, `whoami`, `date`, `echo`, `cat`, `head`, `tail`, `wc`, `grep`, `uname`, `uptime`, `df`, `du`, `free`, `hostname`, `id`, `env`, `printenv`\n\n## Usage\n\n```javascript\n// Start command server\nconst { port } = await NativeSDK.sshServer.start({\n  port: NativeSDK.sshServer.getClients();\nclients.forEach(c => {\n  console.log(`${c.id}: ${c.username} from ${c.remoteAddress} (${c.commands} commands)`);\n});\n\n// Kick user\nawait `lib/plugins/tcp_server/README.md`\n\n```markdown\n# TCP Server Plugin\n\nAccept incoming TCP connections and exchange data.\n\n## Plugin Name\n`tcpServer`\n\n## Methods\n\n| Method | Description |\n|--------|-------------|\n| `start` | Start TCP server on port |\n| `stop` | Stop specific server |\n| `stopAll` | Stop all servers |\n| `sendToClient` | Send data to specific client |\n| `sendToAll` | Broadcast to all clients |\n| `disconnectClient` | Disconnect a client |\n| `getClients` | List connected clients |\n| `getServers` | List running servers |\n\n### start\n| Param | Type | Default |\n|-------|------|---------|\n| `port` | `number` | `0` (random) |\n| `host` | `string` | `\"0.0.0.0\"` |\n| `id` | `string` | auto |\n| `maxClients` | `number` | `100` |\n| `encoding` | `string` | `\"utf8\"` |\n\n## Events\n| Event | Data |\n|-------|------|\n| `tcpServer.started` | `{ serverId, port }` |\n| `tcpServer.clientConnected` | `{ serverId, clientId, remoteAddress }` |\n| `tcpServer.data` | `{ serverId, clientId, data, bytes }` |\n| `tcpServer.clientDisconnected` | `{ serverId, clientId }` |\n\n## Usage\n```javascript\n// Start server\nconst srv = await NativeSDK.tcpServer.start({ port: 9000, maxClients: 50 });\nconsole.log('Server on port', srv.port);\n\n// Handle data\nNativeSDK.on('tcpServer.data', (msg) => {\n  console.log(`[${msg.clientId}]: ${msg.data}`);\n  // Echo back\n  NativeSDK.tcpServer.sendToClient(msg.serverId, msg.clientId, 'ACK: ' + msg.data);\n});\n\n// Handle connections\nNativeSDK.on('tcpServer.clientConnected', (info) => {\n  NativeSDK.tcpServer.sendToClient(info.serverId, info.clientId, 'Welcome!');\n});\n\n// Broadcast to all\nawait NativeSDK.tcpServer.sendToAll(srv.id, 'Server announcement');\n\n// List clients\nconst { clients } = await NativeSDK.tcpServer.getClients(srv.id);\n\n// Stop\nawait NativeSDK.tcpServer.stop(srv.id);\n```\n```\n\n---\n\n## 📄
